title: Flexible Bit-Truncation Memory for Approximate Applications on the Edge
summary: Bit truncation has demonstrated great potential to enable run-time quality-power adaptive data storage, thereby optimizing the power/energy efficiency of approximate applications and supporting their deployment in edge environments. However, existing bit-truncation memories require custom designs for a specific application. In this paper, we present a novel bit-truncation memory with full adaptation flexibility, which can truncate any number of data bits at run time to meet different quality and power trade-off requirements for various approximate applications. The developed bit-truncation memory has been applied to two representative data-intensive approximate applications: video processing and deep learning. Our experiments show that the proposed memory can support three different video applications (including luminance-aware, content-aware, and region-of-interest-aware) with enhanced power efficiency (up to 47.02% power savings) as compared to state-of-the-art. In addition, the proposed memory achieves significant (up to 51.69%) power savings for both baseline and pruned lightweight deep learning models, respectively, with a low implementation cost (2.89% silicon area overhead).

AI.title_translation: 针对边缘近似应用的灵活位截断存储器
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种灵活的位截断存储器，可以在运行时截断任意位数，以适应不同的近似应用（如视频处理和深度学习），实现了显著的功耗节省（最高达51.69%），且硬件开销很小。
AI.motivation: 现有的位截断存储器需要针对特定的近似应用进行定制设计。作者的动机是开发一种具有完全适应灵活性的新型位截断存储器，能够在运行时截断任意数量的数据位，以满足各种近似应用对质量和功耗的不同权衡要求。
AI.method: 提出了一种新型的、具有完全适应灵活性的位截断存储器。该存储器能够在运行时截断任意数量的数据位。
AI.result: 在视频处理应用中，功耗效率得到提升（功耗节省高达47.02%）。在基线和剪枝轻量级深度学习模型中，功耗节省显著（高达51.69%）。实现成本低，硅面积开销仅为2.89%。
AI.translation: 位截断技术已展现出巨大的潜力，能够实现运行时质量-功耗自适应数据存储，从而优化近似应用的功耗/能效，并支持其在边缘环境中的部署。然而，现有的位截断存储器需要针对特定应用进行定制设计。在本文中，我们提出了一种具有完全适应灵活性的新型位截断存储器，它可以在运行时截断任意数量的数据位，以满足各种近似应用对不同质量和功耗权衡的要求。所开发的位截断存储器已应用于两个代表性的数据密集型近似应用：视频处理和深度学习。我们的实验表明，与现有技术相比，所提出的存储器能够支持三种不同的视频应用（包括亮度感知、内容感知和感兴趣区域感知），并提高了功耗效率（功耗节省高达47.02%）。此外，所提出的存储器在基线和剪枝轻量级深度学习模型中均实现了显著的功耗节省（高达51.69%），且实现成本低（硅面积开销为2.89%）。
AI.summary: 针对现有位截断存储器缺乏通用性、需要定制设计的问题，本文提出了一种灵活的位截断存储器。该存储器具有完全的运行时适应性，能够根据近似应用的质量和功耗需求，动态截断任意数量的数据位。实验证明，该技术在视频处理和深度学习等数据密集型边缘应用中表现出色，功耗节省最高可达51.69%，同时仅带来2.89%的硅面积开销。
AI.keywords: 位截断存储器, 近似应用, 边缘计算, 功耗优化, 运行时适应性
AI.comments: 本文的关键创新在于实现了位截断存储器的“完全适应灵活性”，使其能够成为一种通用的、可配置的近似计算硬件加速组件，而非针对特定应用的定制方案。这对于推动近似计算在资源受限的边缘设备上的广泛部署至关重要，因为它能动态调整功耗和精度，以适应不断变化的边缘工作负载和环境。其重要性在于提供了一种高能效比的内存解决方案，显著降低了深度学习和视频处理等数据密集型任务的边缘部署能耗。局限性（从摘要推断）：摘要未详细说明这种灵活性的具体电路实现细节，也未讨论动态截断对应用精度（质量）的具体影响程度。

title: Light Field Display Point Rendering
comments: 18 pages, 11 figures, Published in Proceedings of the ACM on Computer Graphics and Interactive Techniques, Vol. 7, Issue. 1 (May 2024)
summary: Rendering for light field displays (LFDs) requires rendering of dozens or hundreds of views, which must then be combined into a single image on the display, making real-time LFD rendering extremely difficult. We introduce light field display point rendering (LFDPR), which meets these challenges by improving eye-based point rendering [Gavane and Watson 2023] with texture-based splatting, which avoids oversampling of triangles mapped to only a few texels; and with LFD-biased sampling, which adjusts horizontal and vertical triangle sampling to match the sampling of the LFD itself. To improve image quality, we introduce multiview mipmapping, which reduces texture aliasing even though compute shaders do not support hardware mipmapping. We also introduce angular supersampling and reconstruction to combat LFD view aliasing and crosstalk. The resulting LFDPR is 2-8x times faster than multiview rendering, with similar comparable quality.
comment: 18 pages, 11 figures, Published in Proceedings of the ACM on Computer Graphics and Interactive Techniques, Vol. 7, Issue. 1 (May 2024)

AI.tldr: 实时光场显示（LFD）渲染速度慢。本文提出了LFDPR，一种点渲染方法，通过纹理喷溅、LFD偏置采样和多视图Mipmap等技术，显著提高了渲染速度（快2-8倍），同时保持了图像质量。
AI.motivation: 光场显示（LFDs）的渲染需要渲染数十到数百个视图，然后将它们组合成显示器上的单个图像，这使得实时LFD渲染极其困难。
AI.method: 本文提出了光场显示点渲染（LFDPR）技术，它在眼基点渲染的基础上进行了改进。主要方法包括：基于纹理的喷溅（避免三角形过采样）、LFD偏置采样（匹配LFD的采样）、多视图Mipmap（在计算着色器不支持硬件Mipmap的情况下减少纹理混叠），以及角度超采样和重建（对抗LFD视图混叠和串扰）。
AI.result: 结果表明，LFDPR比多视图渲染快2到8倍，同时保持了相似的可比图像质量。
AI.conclusion: LFDPR通过提供一种比传统多视图渲染显著更快且质量相当的方法，有效地解决了实时光场显示渲染的挑战。
AI.translation: 光场显示器（LFDs）的渲染需要渲染数十或数百个视图，然后必须将它们组合成显示器上的单个图像，这使得实时LFD渲染极其困难。我们引入了光场显示点渲染（LFDPR），它通过以下方式应对这些挑战：使用基于纹理的喷溅改进了眼基点渲染[Gavane and Watson 2023]，从而避免了映射到少数纹理元素的三角形的过度采样；并使用LFD偏置采样，调整水平和垂直三角形采样以匹配LFD本身的采样。为了提高图像质量，我们引入了多视图Mipmap，即使计算着色器不支持硬件Mipmap，它也能减少纹理混叠。我们还引入了角度超采样和重建来对抗LFD视图混叠和串扰。最终的LFDPR比多视图渲染快2到8倍，并具有相似的可比质量。
AI.summary: LFDPR是一种新颖的点渲染技术，旨在克服实时光场显示（LFD）渲染的计算难度。它在眼基点渲染的基础上，结合了基于纹理的喷溅和LFD偏置采样以提高效率，并引入了多视图Mipmap和角度超采样来改善图像质量。该方法比传统多视图渲染快2-8倍，同时保持了相当的视觉质量。
AI.keywords: 光场显示, 点渲染, 实时渲染, 纹理喷溅, 多视图Mipmap
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将点渲染（LFDPR）适应于光场显示（LFDs）的特定挑战。使用基于纹理的喷溅和LFD偏置采样，通过防止不必要的计算（过采样）并将渲染过程与显示硬件的固有采样结构对齐，从而提高了效率。引入“多视图Mipmap”是一个巧妙的工程解决方案，用于在受限的计算着色器环境中实现抗混叠。在保持质量的同时实现2-8倍的加速，对于使LFD技术在实时应用中变得实用具有高度重要性。

title: A Flower-Inspired Solution for Computer Memory Wear-Leveling
summary: Lengthening a computer memory's lifespan is important for e-waste and sustainability. Uneven wear of memory is a major barrier. The problem is becoming even more urgent as emerging memory such as phase-change memory is subject to even shorter lifespan. Various solutions have been proposed, but they either require complicated hardware extensions or apply only to certain program constructs such as loops. This research proposes a new method, dual-ring wear leveling. It takes inspiration from the natural law known as the ``golden ratio" and how it helps flower petals evenly receive sun lights. By modeling memory as two rings and combines the idea with existing memory management, garbage collection, the new solution offers an effective way to reduce memory wear and hence lengthen memory lifespan. It is deterministic, able to automatically adapt to memory size, requiring no hardware changes, and adding no slowdown to program executions.

AI.title_translation: 计算机内存磨损均衡的一种花朵启发式解决方案
AI.tldr: 为解决内存磨损不均导致的寿命缩短问题，本文提出了一种受黄金比例和花朵启发的新型“双环磨损均衡”方法。该方法无需硬件改动，不影响程序运行速度，并能有效延长内存寿命。
AI.motivation: 延长计算机内存寿命对减少电子垃圾和可持续性至关重要。内存磨损不均是主要障碍，尤其对相变内存等新兴内存（如相变内存）而言，问题更加紧迫。现有解决方案通常需要复杂的硬件扩展或仅适用于特定的程序结构（如循环）。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“双环磨损均衡”（dual-ring wear leveling）的新方法。该方法灵感来源于自然界中的“黄金比例”，以及花瓣如何均匀接收阳光的原理。通过将内存建模为两个环，并将其与现有的内存管理和垃圾回收机制相结合。
AI.result: 该方案是确定性的，能够自动适应内存大小，不需要进行硬件更改，并且不会给程序执行带来额外的性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 该“双环磨损均衡”解决方案提供了一种有效减少内存磨损、延长内存寿命的方法。它具有确定性、自适应性、无需硬件修改且不影响程序性能的优点。
AI.translation: 延长计算机内存的寿命对于减少电子垃圾和实现可持续性至关重要。内存磨损不均是一个主要的障碍。随着相变内存等新兴内存的出现，其寿命更短，使得这个问题变得更加紧迫。现有的各种解决方案要么需要复杂的硬件扩展，要么仅适用于某些程序结构，例如循环。本研究提出了一种新的方法，即双环磨损均衡。它从被称为“黄金比例”的自然法则以及该比例如何帮助花瓣均匀接收阳光中获取灵感。通过将内存建模为两个环，并将其与现有的内存管理、垃圾回收等概念相结合，该新方案提供了一种有效减少内存磨损、从而延长内存寿命的方法。它具有确定性，能够自动适应内存大小，无需硬件更改，并且不会增加程序执行的减速。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种受自然界“黄金比例”启发的“双环磨损均衡”新方法，旨在解决计算机内存（尤其是新兴内存如相变内存）因磨损不均导致的寿命缩短问题。该方案通过将内存建模为双环并结合垃圾回收等现有机制，实现了有效的磨损减少。其主要优势在于无需硬件修改，能够自动适应内存大小，且不增加程序执行的性能开销。
AI.keywords: 磨损均衡, 黄金比例, 双环, 相变内存, 垃圾回收
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新点在于将自然界（花朵的黄金比例）的仿生学原理应用于解决计算机系统中的实际工程问题——内存磨损均衡。这种跨学科的灵感来源提供了一种优雅且低开销的软件级解决方案，避免了现有方法中常见的复杂硬件需求或对特定程序结构的依赖。如果该方法确实能实现“不增加程序执行的减速”，这将是其最大的价值和优势，尤其适用于对性能敏感的系统。

title: STELLAR: Structure-guided LLM Assertion Retrieval and Generation for Formal Verification
summary: Formal Verification (FV) relies on high-quality SystemVerilog Assertions (SVAs), but the manual writing process is slow and error-prone. Existing LLM-based approaches either generate assertions from scratch or ignore structural patterns in hardware designs and expert-crafted assertions. This paper presents STELLAR, the first framework that guides LLM-based SVA generation with structural similarity. STELLAR represents RTL blocks as AST structural fingerprints, retrieves structurally relevant (RTL, SVA) pairs from a knowledge base, and integrates them into structure-guided prompts. Experiments show that STELLAR achieves superior syntax correctness, stylistic alignment, and functional correctness, highlighting structure-aware retrieval as a promising direction for industrial FV.

AI.title_translation: STELLAR：面向形式化验证的结构引导式LLM断言检索与生成
AI.tldr: STELLAR是一个利用抽象语法树（AST）结构指纹来指导大型语言模型（LLM）生成SystemVerilog断言（SVA）的框架，通过检索结构相似的断言对来提高生成断言的语法、风格和功能正确性，解决了手动编写SVA慢且易错的问题。
AI.motivation: 形式化验证（FV）依赖高质量的SystemVerilog断言（SVA），但手动编写过程缓慢且容易出错。现有的基于LLM的方法要么从头开始生成断言，要么忽略硬件设计和专家断言中的结构模式，效果不佳。
AI.method: 本文提出了STELLAR框架，它是第一个利用结构相似性来指导LLM进行SVA生成的框架。STELLAR将RTL块表示为抽象语法树（AST）结构指纹，从知识库中检索结构相关的（RTL, SVA）对，并将其整合到结构引导式提示中。
AI.result: 实验证明，STELLAR在语法正确性、风格一致性和功能正确性方面均取得了优越的性能。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知检索是工业形式化验证的一个有前景的方向。
AI.translation: 形式化验证（FV）依赖于高质量的SystemVerilog断言（SVA），但手动编写过程缓慢且容易出错。现有的基于LLM的方法要么从头开始生成断言，要么忽略硬件设计和专家编写断言中的结构模式。本文提出了STELLAR，这是第一个利用结构相似性来指导基于LLM的SVA生成的框架。STELLAR将RTL块表示为AST结构指纹，从知识库中检索结构相关的（RTL, SVA）对，并将其整合到结构引导式提示中。实验表明，STELLAR实现了卓越的语法正确性、风格一致性和功能正确性，突显了结构感知检索作为工业FV的一个有前景的方向。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了STELLAR框架，旨在解决形式化验证中手动编写高质量SystemVerilog断言（SVA）效率低且易错的问题。STELLAR通过将RTL块转换为AST结构指纹，实现结构相似性指导的LLM断言生成。它从知识库中检索结构相关的RTL-SVA对，并将其用于构建结构引导式提示，从而显著提高了生成断言的语法、风格和功能正确性。
AI.keywords: 形式化验证, SystemVerilog断言, LLM, 结构引导, AST指纹
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于首次将硬件设计的结构信息（通过AST结构指纹表示）引入到LLM辅助的断言生成过程中。通过结构感知检索而非单纯的文本匹配，它能够更好地利用现有专家知识，确保生成的断言不仅语法正确，而且在功能上与目标硬件设计结构高度相关，为工业级形式化验证提供了一种更可靠、更高效的自动化方法。

title: DABench-LLM: Standardized and In-Depth Benchmarking of Post-Moore Dataflow AI Accelerators for LLMs
summary: The exponential growth of large language models has outpaced the capabilities of traditional CPU and GPU architectures due to the slowdown of Moore's Law. Dataflow AI accelerators present a promising alternative; however, there remains a lack of in-depth performance analysis and standardized benchmarking methodologies for LLM training. We introduce DABench-LLM, the first benchmarking framework designed for evaluating LLM workloads on dataflow-based accelerators. By combining intra-chip performance profiling and inter-chip scalability analysis, DABench-LLM enables comprehensive evaluation across key metrics such as resource allocation, load balance, and resource efficiency. The framework helps researchers rapidly gain insights into underlying hardware and system behaviors, and provides guidance for performance optimizations. We validate DABench-LLM on three commodity dataflow accelerators, Cerebras WSE-2, SambaNova RDU, and Graphcore IPU. Our framework reveals performance bottlenecks and provides specific optimization strategies, demonstrating its generality and effectiveness across a diverse range of dataflow-based AI hardware platforms.

AI.title_translation: DABench-LLM：面向后摩尔时代数据流AI加速器的标准化深度LLM基准测试
AI.tldr: 针对后摩尔时代的数据流AI加速器，我们推出了DABench-LLM，这是首个用于LLM工作负载的标准化深度基准测试框架，它通过结合片内和片间分析来识别性能瓶颈并指导优化。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的指数级增长超越了传统CPU和GPU架构的性能，且缺乏针对数据流AI加速器进行LLM训练的深度性能分析和标准化基准测试方法。
AI.method: 提出了DABench-LLM，这是首个用于评估数据流加速器上LLM工作负载的基准测试框架。该框架结合了片内性能分析（intra-chip performance profiling）和片间可扩展性分析（inter-chip scalability analysis）。
AI.result: 框架实现了对资源分配、负载平衡和资源效率等关键指标的全面评估。它能够帮助研究人员快速获取硬件和系统行为的洞察，并提供性能优化指导。在三种商用数据流加速器上验证了其通用性和有效性，揭示了性能瓶颈并提供了具体的优化策略。
AI.conclusion: 该框架具有通用性和有效性，适用于各种数据流AI硬件平台，能够为性能优化提供指导。
AI.translation: 由于摩尔定律的放缓，大语言模型的指数级增长已经超越了传统CPU和GPU架构的能力。数据流AI加速器提供了一个有前景的替代方案；然而，针对LLM训练，目前仍缺乏深入的性能分析和标准化的基准测试方法。我们引入了DABench-LLM，这是首个专为评估数据流加速器上LLM工作负载而设计的基准测试框架。通过结合片内性能分析和片间可扩展性分析，DABench-LLM能够对资源分配、负载平衡和资源效率等关键指标进行全面评估。该框架帮助研究人员快速获得对底层硬件和系统行为的洞察，并为性能优化提供指导。我们在三种商用数据流加速器（Cerebras WSE-2、SambaNova RDU和Graphcore IPU）上验证了DABench-LLM。我们的框架揭示了性能瓶颈并提供了具体的优化策略，证明了其在各种数据流AI硬件平台上的通用性和有效性。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了DABench-LLM，这是首个用于评估大型语言模型工作负载在数据流AI加速器上性能的标准化基准测试框架。它旨在解决传统CPU/GPU性能瓶颈和现有数据流加速器缺乏深度评估的问题。DABench-LLM结合了片内性能分析和片间可扩展性分析，全面评估资源分配、负载平衡和效率等指标。通过在多种商用加速器上的验证，证明了该框架能够有效揭示性能瓶颈并提供优化策略。
AI.keywords: 数据流AI加速器, LLM, 基准测试, 性能分析, 后摩尔时代
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了首个针对LLM工作负载在数据流AI加速器上的标准化、深度基准测试框架。鉴于摩尔定律放缓，数据流加速器成为LLM训练的关键替代方案，该框架填补了这一领域缺乏系统化性能分析的空白。通过结合片内性能剖析和片间可扩展性分析，DABench-LLM提供了对底层硬件和系统行为的深入洞察，对于指导下一代AI硬件设计和系统级优化具有重要意义。

title: Hardware-Aware Model Design and Training of Silicon-based Analog Neural Networks
summary:
Silicon-based analog neural networks physically embody the ideal neural network model in an approximate way. We show that by retraining the neural network using a physics-informed hardware-aware model one can fully recover the inference accuracy of the ideal network model even in the presence of significant non-idealities. This is way more promising for scalability and integration density than the default option of improving the fidelity of the analog neural network at the cost of significant energy, area, and design overhead, through extensive calibration and conservative analog design.
  We first present a physics-informed hardware-aware model for a time-domain vector-matrix multiplier implemented with single-transistor floating-gate memory cells that explicitly accounts for two dominant non-idealities of the physical implementation - capacitive crosstalk and bit-line voltage drop - and integrates seamlessly with modern deep-learning workflows. The model discretizes each operation into adaptive time slots, processes activation patterns in parallel, and accumulates their contributions to predict effective multiplier outputs. Using measurements from a 16x16 silicon array, we calibrate the model, show that crosstalk is layout-dependent and often dominant, and introduce an improved weight-extraction procedure that doubles signal-to-error ratio versus an ideal vector-matrix multiplier model. Finally, we show that by training silicon-based analog neural networks using an hardware-aware model in the forward pass we can recover the accuracy of the ideal software networks across three architectures -- custom MLP on low-resolution MNIST, LeNet-5 on MNIST, and a VGG-style CNN on CIFAR-10 - establishing a complete design-to-deployment workflow for time-domain analog neuromorphic chips.

AI.title_translation: 基于硅基模拟神经网络的硬件感知模型设计与训练
AI.tldr: 通过使用物理信息和硬件感知的模型对硅基模拟神经网络进行再训练，可以完全恢复其理想软件网络的推理精度，这比传统的硬件改进方法更具可扩展性和集成密度。
AI.motivation: 硅基模拟神经网络在物理实现中存在显著的非理想性，导致推理精度下降。传统的通过大量校准和保守设计来提高模拟网络保真度的方法，会带来高昂的能量、面积和设计开销，限制了可扩展性和集成密度。因此需要一种更具前景的替代方案来恢复精度。
AI.method: 1. 提出一个物理信息硬件感知模型，用于基于单晶体管浮栅存储单元实现的时域向量-矩阵乘法器（VMM）。2. 该模型明确考虑了两个主要的物理非理想性：容性串扰和位线电压下降。3. 模型将操作离散为自适应时间槽，并行处理激活模式，并累积贡献以预测输出。4. 使用16x16硅阵列的测量数据对模型进行校准。5. 引入改进的权重提取程序，使信噪比提高一倍。6. 使用硬件感知模型在正向传播中对网络进行再训练。
AI.result: 1. 通过使用硬件感知模型进行训练，在三种架构上（低分辨率MNIST上的定制MLP、MNIST上的LeNet-5、CIFAR-10上的VGG式CNN）恢复了理想软件网络的精度。2. 实验表明串扰是与布局相关的且通常是主要的非理想因素。3. 改进的权重提取程序使信噪比（SER）相对于理想VMM模型提高了一倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过在正向传播中使用硬件感知模型训练硅基模拟神经网络，可以恢复理想软件网络的精度，从而建立了时域模拟神经形态芯片从设计到部署的完整工作流程。
AI.translation: 硅基模拟神经网络以近似的方式物理实现了理想的神经网络模型。我们表明，通过使用物理信息硬件感知模型对神经网络进行再训练，即使存在显著的非理想性，也能完全恢复理想网络模型的推理精度。与默认的通过大量校准和保守模拟设计以牺牲显著的能量、面积和设计开销来提高模拟神经网络保真度的方法相比，这对于可扩展性和集成密度更有前景。我们首先提出了一个用于时域向量-矩阵乘法器（使用单晶体管浮栅存储单元实现）的物理信息硬件感知模型，该模型明确考虑了物理实现中的两个主要非理想性——容性串扰和位线电压下降，并与现代深度学习工作流程无缝集成。该模型将每个操作离散为自适应时间槽，并行处理激活模式，并累积它们的贡献以预测有效的乘法器输出。利用16x16硅阵列的测量结果，我们校准了该模型，表明串扰是与布局相关的且通常是主要的非理想因素，并引入了一种改进的权重提取程序，使信噪比相对于理想向量-矩阵乘法器模型提高了一倍。最后，我们展示了通过在正向传播中使用硬件感知模型训练硅基模拟神经网络，可以在三种架构上（低分辨率MNIST上的定制MLP、MNIST上的LeNet-5以及CIFAR-10上的VGG式CNN）恢复理想软件网络的精度，从而为时域模拟神经形态芯片建立了完整的设计到部署的工作流程。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种创新的硬件感知再训练方法，用于解决硅基模拟神经网络（ANNs）中的非理想性问题（如串扰和电压下降）。通过引入一个物理信息模型，该模型能准确模拟时域向量-矩阵乘法器中的硬件误差，并无缝集成到深度学习流程中。实验证明，在不进行昂贵硬件改进的情况下，仅通过软件再训练，该方法成功地在多个标准数据集和网络架构上恢复了模拟网络与理想软件网络相同的推理精度，为模拟神经形态芯片提供了一个高效率、高集成度的设计部署方案。
AI.keywords: 硅基模拟神经网络, 硬件感知模型, 物理信息训练, 向量-矩阵乘法器, 非理想性恢复
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于提出了一个物理信息硬件感知模型，并将硬件非理想性（特别是串扰和位线电压下降）纳入深度学习的训练（再训练）流程中，从而在软件层面弥补硬件的不足。这避免了传统上通过高成本硬件改进（如大量校准和保守设计）来提高模拟精度的限制，极大地提高了硅基模拟神经网络的可扩展性和集成密度，为模拟神经形态计算的实际应用铺平了道路。

title: GTAC: A Generative Transformer for Approximate Circuits
summary: Targeting error-tolerant applications, approximate circuits introduce controlled errors to significantly improve performance, power, and area (PPA) of circuits. In this work, we introduce GTAC, a novel generative Transformer-based model for producing approximate circuits. By leveraging principles of approximate computing and AI-driven EDA, our model innovatively integrates error thresholds into the design process. Experimental results show that compared with a state-of-the-art method, GTAC further reduces 6.4% area under the error rate constraint, while being 4.3x faster.

AI.title_translation: GTAC：一种用于近似电路的生成式 Transformer
AI.tldr: 提出 GTAC 模型，它是一种基于 Transformer 的生成式模型，用于在满足错误率约束下，快速生成面积更小的近似电路。
AI.motivation: 针对容错应用，近似电路通过引入可控错误来显著改善电路的性能、功耗和面积（PPA）。
AI.method: 引入了 GTAC，一种新颖的基于生成式 Transformer 的模型来生成近似电路。该模型利用近似计算和 AI 驱动的 EDA 原理，创新性地将错误阈值集成到设计过程中。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，在错误率约束下，与现有最先进方法相比，GTAC 进一步减少了 6.4% 的面积，同时速度提高了 4.3 倍。
AI.translation: 针对容错应用，近似电路引入了可控错误，从而显著改善了电路的性能、功耗和面积（PPA）。在这项工作中，我们介绍了 GTAC，一种新颖的基于生成式 Transformer 的模型，用于生成近似电路。通过利用近似计算和 AI 驱动的 EDA 的原理，我们的模型创新性地将错误阈值集成到设计过程中。实验结果表明，与现有最先进方法相比，在错误率约束下，GTAC 进一步减少了 6.4% 的面积，同时速度提高了 4.3 倍。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 GTAC，一个用于设计近似电路的生成式 Transformer 模型。该模型将近似计算和 AI-EDA 原理相结合，并在设计过程中整合了错误阈值。实验证明，GTAC 在保持错误率约束的前提下，比现有技术减少了 6.4% 的面积，并实现了 4.3 倍的速度提升。
AI.keywords: 近似电路, 生成式 Transformer, 错误阈值, AI-驱动 EDA, PPA 优化
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将生成式 Transformer 模型引入到近似电路的设计自动化（EDA）领域。通过将错误阈值直接整合到 AI 驱动的设计流程中，GTAC 实现了在 PPA 优化（面积减少）和设计速度上的显著提升，展示了 AI 在加速和优化硬件设计方面的巨大潜力。

title: RAPID-Graph: Recursive All-Pairs Shortest Paths Using Processing-in-Memory for Dynamic Programming on Graphs
summary: All-pairs shortest paths (APSP) remains a major bottleneck for large-scale graph analytics, as data movement with cubic complexity overwhelms the bandwidth of conventional memory hierarchies. In this work, we propose RAPID-Graph to address this challenge through a co-designed processing-in-memory (PIM) system that integrates algorithm, architecture, and device-level optimizations. At the algorithm level, we introduce a recursion-aware partitioner that enables an exact APSP computation by decomposing graphs into vertex tiles to reduce data dependency, such that both Floyd-Warshall and Min-Plus kernels execute fully in-place within digital PIM arrays. At the architecture and device levels, we design a 2.5D PIM stack integrating two phase-change memory compute dies, a logic die, and high-bandwidth scratchpad memory within a unified advanced package. An external non-volatile storage stack stores large APSP results persistently. The design achieves both tile-level and unit-level parallel processing to sustain high throughput. On the 2.45M-node OGBN-Products dataset, RAPID-Graph is 5.8x faster and 1,186x more energy efficient than state-of-the-art GPU clusters, while exceeding prior PIM accelerators by 8.3x in speed and 104x in efficiency. It further delivers up to 42.8x speedup and 392x energy savings over an NVIDIA H100 GPU.

AI.title_translation: RAPID-Graph：使用内存处理进行图上动态规划的递归全对最短路径
AI.tldr: RAPID-Graph是一个协同设计的内存处理(PIM)系统，通过算法、架构和设备级优化，显著加速了大规模图分析中的全对最短路径(APSP)计算，相比现有GPU集群和PIM加速器，实现了显著的速度和能效提升。
AI.motivation: 大规模图分析中的全对最短路径(APSP)计算是主要瓶颈，因为其立方复杂度的数据移动会严重消耗传统内存层次结构的带宽。
AI.method: RAPID-Graph通过协同设计的内存处理(PIM)系统解决APSP问题，该系统整合了算法、架构和设备级优化。在算法层面，引入了递归感知的分区器，将图分解为顶点瓦片以减少数据依赖，使Floyd-Warshall和Min-Plus核函数能在数字PIM阵列中完全原地执行。在架构和设备层面，设计了一个2.5D PIM堆栈，在一个统一的高级封装中集成了两个相变存储计算芯片、一个逻辑芯片和高带宽暂存存储器。外部非易失性存储堆栈持久存储大型APSP结果。该设计实现了瓦片级和单元级并行处理以维持高吞吐量。
AI.result: 在2.45M节点的OGBN-Products数据集上，RAPID-Graph比最先进的GPU集群快5.8倍，能效高1,186倍，同时在速度上超过之前的PIM加速器8.3倍，在效率上高104倍。它还比NVIDIA H100 GPU实现了高达42.8倍的加速和392倍的能耗节省。
AI.conclusion: RAPID-Graph通过其协同设计的PIM系统，在处理大规模图的全对最短路径问题上，相比现有GPU集群和PIM加速器，展示了卓越的速度和能效提升。
AI.translation: 所有对最短路径 (APSP) 仍然是大规模图分析的主要瓶颈，因为具有立方复杂度的数据移动会使传统内存层次结构的带宽不堪重负。在这项工作中，我们提出了 RAPID-Graph，通过协同设计的内存处理 (PIM) 系统来解决这一挑战，该系统集成了算法、架构和设备级优化。在算法层面，我们引入了一个递归感知分区器，通过将图分解为顶点瓦片来减少数据依赖，从而实现精确的 APSP 计算，使得 Floyd-Warshall 和 Min-Plus 内核都可以在数字 PIM 阵列中完全原地执行。在架构和设备层面，我们设计了一个 2.5D PIM 堆栈，在一个统一的高级封装中集成了两个相变存储计算芯片、一个逻辑芯片和高带宽暂存存储器。外部非易失性存储堆栈持久存储大型 APSP 结果。该设计实现了瓦片级和单元级并行处理以维持高吞吐量。在 2.45M 节点的 OGBN-Products 数据集上，RAPID-Graph 比最先进的 GPU 集群快 5.8 倍，能效高 1,186 倍，同时在速度上超过之前的 PIM 加速器 8.3 倍，在效率上高 104 倍。它还比 NVIDIA H100 GPU 提供了高达 42.8 倍的加速和 392 倍的能耗节省。
AI.summary: RAPID-Graph 提出了一种协同设计的内存处理 (PIM) 系统，旨在解决大规模图分析中全对最短路径 (APSP) 计算的数据移动瓶颈。该系统通过引入递归感知分区器在算法层面优化，使得 Floyd-Warshall 和 Min-Plus 算法能在 PIM 阵列中原地执行。在硬件层面，设计了一个集成了相变存储器和逻辑芯片的 2.5D PIM 堆栈，并支持瓦片级和单元级并行处理。实验结果表明，RAPID-Graph 在速度和能效上显著优于现有 GPU 集群和 PIM 加速器，甚至超越了 NVIDIA H100 GPU。
AI.keywords: 全对最短路径, 内存处理, 图计算, 动态规划, RAPID-Graph
AI.comments: RAPID-Graph的创新之处在于其将算法、架构和设备级优化深度整合到内存处理(PIM)系统中，以解决APSP计算中的数据移动瓶颈。特别是递归感知分区器和2.5D PIM堆栈的设计，展现了对计算效率和能耗的极致追求。该工作为大规模图计算提供了一个极具前景的硬件加速方案。

title: CHIME: Chiplet-based Heterogeneous Near-Memory Acceleration for Edge Multimodal LLM Inference
summary: The proliferation of large language models (LLMs) is accelerating the integration of multimodal assistants into edge devices, where inference is executed under stringent latency and energy constraints, often exacerbated by intermittent connectivity. These challenges become particularly acute in the context of multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), as high-dimensional visual inputs are transformed into extensive token sequences, thereby inflating the key-value (KV) cache and imposing substantial data movement overheads to the LLM backbone. To address these issues, we present CHIME, a chiplet-based heterogeneous near-memory acceleration for edge MLLMs inference. CHIME leverages the complementary strengths of integrated monolithic 3D (M3D) DRAM and RRAM chiplets: DRAM supplies low-latency bandwidth for attention, while RRAM offers dense, non-volatile storage for weights. This heterogeneous hardware is orchestrated by a co-designed mapping framework that executes fused kernels near data, minimizing cross-chiplet traffic to maximize effective bandwidth. On FastVLM (0.6B/1.7B) and MobileVLM (1.7B/3B), CHIME achieves up to 54x speedup and up to 246x better energy efficiency per inference as compared to the edge GPU NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. It sustains 116.5-266.5 token/J compared to Jetson's 0.7-1.1 token/J. Furthermore, it delivers up to 69.2x higher throughput than the state-of-the-art PIM accelerator FACIL. Compared to the M3D DRAM-only design, CHIME's heterogeneous memory further improves energy efficiency by 7% and performance by 2.4x.

AI.title_translation: 基于芯粒的异构近内存加速器，用于边缘多模态大语言模型推理
AI.tldr: CHIME是一种基于芯粒的异构近内存加速器，用于解决边缘多模态大语言模型（MLLM）推理中的延迟和能耗瓶颈。它结合了3D DRAM和RRAM芯粒的优势，通过近数据计算和优化的映射框架，显著提高了推理速度和能效，相较于边缘GPU和现有PIM加速器具有明显优势。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备上的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）推理面临严格的延迟和能耗限制，尤其是在处理高维视觉输入时，这会急剧增加KV缓存并产生大量数据移动开销。
AI.method: CHIME采用基于芯粒的异构近内存架构，结合了3D DRAM（用于低延迟带宽）和RRAM（用于密集非易失性权重存储）。通过协同设计的映射框架，将计算移近数据，最小化跨芯粒通信。
AI.result: CHIME在FastVLM和MobileVLM上实现了高达54倍的速度提升和246倍的能效提升（相对于Jetson Orin NX）。其能效达到116.5-266.5 token/J，远高于Jetson的0.7-1.1 token/J。与现有PIM加速器FACIL相比，吞吐量提高了69.2倍。与仅使用3D DRAM的设计相比，CHIME在能效上提高了7%，性能提高了2.4倍。
AI.conclusion: CHIME通过结合DRAM和RRAM芯粒的异构近内存计算，有效解决了边缘MLLM推理的挑战，显著提升了性能和能效，优于现有解决方案。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）的激增正在加速多模态助手集成到边缘设备中，在这些设备上，推理在严格的延迟和能耗限制下执行，而间歇性连接往往会加剧这些限制。这些挑战在多模态LLM（MLLM）的背景下尤为严峻，因为高维视觉输入被转换为广泛的令牌序列，从而膨胀了键值（KV）缓存，并对LLM主干施加了大量的移动开销。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了CHIME，一种用于边缘MLLM推理的基于芯片的异构近内存加速器。CHIME利用集成单片3D（M3D）DRAM和RRAM芯片的互补优势：DRAM为注意力提供低延迟带宽，而RRAM为权重提供密集、非易失性存储。这种异构硬件由协同设计的映射框架进行编排，该框架在数据附近执行融合内核，最大限度地减少跨芯片通信以最大化有效带宽。在FastVLM（0.6B/1.7B）和MobileVLM（1.7B/3B）上，与边缘GPU NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX相比，CHIME实现了高达54倍的速度提升和高达246倍的每推理能效。它相对于Jetson的0.7-1.1 token/J，维持了116.5-266.5 token/J。此外，与最先进的PIM加速器FACIL相比，它的吞吐量提高了69.2倍。与M3D DRAM的单一设计相比，CHIME的异构内存进一步将能效提高了7%，性能提高了2.4倍。
AI.summary: 本文提出CHIME，一种创新的芯粒异构近内存加速器，专门为边缘设备上的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）推理设计。CHIME通过结合DRAM和RRAM芯粒的优势，并采用近数据计算和优化的映射框架，解决了高维输入和KV缓存带来的延迟和能效瓶颈。实验结果表明，CHIME在速度和能效方面均大幅超越了现有的边缘GPU和PIM加速器。
AI.keywords: CHIME, 芯粒, 异构计算, 近内存加速, 多模态大语言模型, 边缘AI
AI.comments: CHIME的设计巧妙地利用了不同类型内存（DRAM和RRAM）的特性，解决了边缘MLLM推理中的关键瓶颈。其近数据计算和优化的映射框架是实现高性能和高能效的关键。然而，实际部署的复杂性和成本可能是一个需要考虑的因素。

title: A Cache-Aware Hybrid Sieve Combining Segmentation and Bit-Packing for Fast Prime Generation
comments: Six pages, two figures, and two tables
summary:
Prime generation is a fundamental task in cryptography, number theory, and randomized algorithms. While the classical Sieve of Eratosthenes is simple and efficient in theory, its practical performance on modern central processing units is often limited by memory access inefficiencies. This paper introduces a cache-aware hybrid sieve that integrates segmentation, bit-packing, and cache-line-aligned block processing to optimize memory bandwidth and level one and level two cache locality.
  The proposed approach reduces memory usage by storing only odd numbers and using one bit per value. The sieve range is divided into cache-sized blocks to minimize cache misses, while primes up to the square root of the limit are reused across blocks. Experimental results demonstrate up to an eight times reduction in memory usage and runtime improvements of up to two point four times compared to the classical sieve and one point seven times compared to the segmented sieve. Benchmarks up to ten to the power of nine illustrate that architecture-aware algorithm design can yield substantial practical performance gains.
comment: Six pages, two figures, and two tables

AI.title_translation: 一种结合分段和位打包的缓存感知混合筛法，用于快速生成素数
AI.tldr: 为了解决传统素数筛法在现代CPU上因内存访问低效而导致的性能瓶颈，本文设计了一种结合了分段、位打包（更省内存）和缓存优化处理的混合筛法，实现了内存使用量大幅减少和运行速度显著提升。
AI.motivation: 经典埃拉托斯特尼筛法在现代CPU上的实际性能受限于内存访问效率低下，尽管其理论上简单高效。目标是提高素数生成的实际性能。
AI.method: 提出了一种缓存感知的混合筛法，它集成了分段、位打包和缓存行对齐的块处理，以优化内存带宽和L1/L2缓存局部性。具体措施包括只存储奇数并使用一位存储一个值，将筛分范围划分为缓存大小的块，并跨块重用小于限制平方根的素数。
AI.result: 与经典筛法相比，内存使用减少了八倍，运行时性能提升了二点四倍；与分段筛法相比，运行时性能提升了一点七倍。
AI.conclusion: 架构感知的算法设计可以带来实质性的实际性能提升，如在十的九次方范围内的基准测试所示。
AI.translation: 素数生成是密码学、数论和随机算法中的一项基本任务。虽然经典的埃拉托斯特尼筛法在理论上简单高效，但其在现代中央处理器上的实际性能通常受到内存访问效率低下的限制。本文介绍了一种缓存感知的混合筛法，它集成了分段、位打包和缓存线对齐的块处理，以优化内存带宽和一级及二级缓存的局部性。所提出的方法通过只存储奇数并为每个值使用一位来减少内存使用。筛分范围被划分为缓存大小的块，以最小化缓存未命中，同时将小于限制平方根的素数跨块重用。实验结果表明，与经典筛法相比，内存使用减少了八倍，运行时间提高了二点四倍；与分段筛法相比，运行时间提高了一点七倍。高达十的九次方的基准测试表明，架构感知的算法设计可以带来实质性的实际性能提升。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新的缓存感知的混合筛法，通过结合分段、位打包（仅存储奇数并使用一位）和缓存线对齐块处理，显著提高了素数生成的内存效率和缓存局部性。实验证明，该方法在减少内存使用和提高运行速度方面，相比经典方法和分段筛法均有显著优势。
AI.keywords: 素数生成, 埃拉托斯特尼筛法, 缓存感知, 位打包, 分段筛法
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将分段、位打包和缓存行对齐处理相结合，以提高现代CPU上素数生成的速度。重要性在于它解决了经典埃拉托斯特尼筛法在内存访问效率上的瓶颈，为密码学和数论等领域提供了更快的实用算法。局限性未在摘要中明确提及，但通常此类优化会牺牲一定的代码简洁性。

title: Understanding Bottlenecks for Efficiently Serving LLM Inference With KV Offloading
summary: KV cache offloading enables long-context LLM inference by storing caches in CPU DRAM, but PCIe bandwidth limitations create severe bottlenecks. In this paper, we develops an analytical framework that derives $κ_{\text{crit}}$, the critical cached-to-prefill token ratio where execution becomes memory-bound and show typical workloads exceed this threshold by orders of magnitude. Empirical characterization reveals 99\% of latency spent on transfers and serving offloaded requests results in GPU's consuming only 28\% of their rated TDP, motivating our proposed optimizations for hardware interconnects, model architectures, and scheduling algorithms.

AI.title_translation: 理解用于高效提供LLM推理的KV卸载瓶颈
AI.tldr: KV缓存卸载受PCIe带宽限制，性能瓶颈严重，GPU利用率低，需要对硬件、模型和调度进行优化。
AI.motivation: KV缓存卸载虽然支持长上下文LLM推理，但PCIe带宽限制造成了严重的性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 开发了一个分析框架，推导出执行开始受限于内存的临界缓存到预填充令牌比率 $κ_{\text{crit}}$；通过经验表征来量化延迟和GPU功耗。
AI.result: 典型工作负载超过 $κ_{\text{crit}}$ 阈值达数个数量级；99%的延迟花费在数据传输上；服务卸载请求时，GPU的TDP仅消耗28%的额定值。
AI.translation: KV缓存卸载通过将缓存存储在CPU DRAM中，支持长上下文LLM推理，但PCIe带宽限制造成了严重的瓶颈。在本文中，我们开发了一个分析框架，推导出执行开始受限于内存的临界缓存到预填充令牌比率 $\kappa_{\text{crit}}$，并表明典型工作负载超过此阈值达数个数量级。经验表征显示，99%的延迟花费在传输上，服务卸载请求导致GPU仅消耗其额定TDP的28%，这为我们提出的关于硬件互连、模型架构和调度算法的优化提供了动机。
AI.summary: 本文研究了用于长上下文LLM推理的KV缓存卸载中存在的PCIe带宽瓶颈问题。研究人员开发了一个分析框架来确定执行开始受限于内存的临界令牌比率 $\kappa_{\text{crit}}$，并经验性地证明当前工作负载远超此阈值，导致大部分延迟用于数据传输，且GPU利用率极低，这为优化硬件互连、模型架构和调度算法提供了依据。
AI.keywords: KV缓存卸载, PCIe带宽, 内存瓶颈, LLM推理, 性能优化
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一个分析框架来量化PCIe带宽瓶颈对KV缓存卸载（KV Offloading）性能的影响，并明确指出了临界比率 $κ_{\text{crit}}$。研究结果揭示了当前工作负载的内存I/O压力巨大，且GPU利用率低下，为后续优化指明了方向。限制在于分析主要集中在PCIe瓶颈，对其他潜在瓶颈的探讨可能不足。

title: GPU-Augmented OLAP Execution Engine: GPU Offloading
comments: 4 pages, figures included. PostgreSQL microbenchmarks and GPU proxy measurements (RTX 4060 Laptop GPU). Extends arXiv:2512.19750 to execution-layer OLAP primitives
summary: Modern OLAP systems have mitigated I/O bottlenecks via storage-compute separation and columnar layouts, but CPU costs in the execution layer (especially Top-K selection and join probe) are emerging as new bottlenecks at scale. This paper proposes a hybrid architecture that augments existing vectorized execution by selectively offloading only high-impact primitives to the GPU. To reduce data movement, we use key-only transfer (keys and pointers) with late materialization. We further introduce a Risky Gate (risk-aware gating) that triggers offloading only in gain/risk intervals based on input size, transfer, kernel and post-processing costs, and candidate-set complexity (K, M). Using PostgreSQL microbenchmarks and GPU proxy measurements, we observe improved tail latency (P95/P99) under gated offloading compared to always-on GPU offloading. This work extends the risk-aware gating principle used for optimizer-stage GPU-assisted measurement (arXiv:2512.19750) to execution-layer OLAP primitives.
comment: 4 pages, figures included. PostgreSQL microbenchmarks and GPU proxy measurements (RTX 4060 Laptop GPU). Extends arXiv:2512.19750 to execution-layer OLAP primitives

AI.tldr: 为了解决OLAP执行层CPU瓶颈，本文提出了一种智能的GPU卸载方案，使用“风险门控”机制来决定何时卸载计算原语，并通过优化数据传输，实现了比持续GPU卸载更好的尾部延迟性能。
AI.motivation: 现代OLAP系统虽然缓解了I/O瓶颈，但在执行层（尤其是Top-K选择和Join探针）的CPU成本正成为大规模部署的新瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出了一种混合架构，通过“键值仅传输”（key-only transfer）和“延迟物化”（late materialization）来减少数据移动。引入了“风险门控”（Risky Gate），根据输入大小、传输、内核、后处理成本以及候选集复杂度（K, M）来确定增益/风险区间，从而有选择地触发GPU卸载。
AI.result: 在PostgreSQL微基准测试和GPU代理测量中，观察到在门控卸载下，与始终开启的GPU卸载相比，尾部延迟（P95/P99）得到了改善。
AI.conclusion: 通过风险门控的GPU卸载策略，在尾部延迟（P95/P99）方面优于始终开启的GPU卸载，证明了选择性卸载的有效性。
AI.translation: 现代OLAP系统通过存储计算分离和列式布局缓解了I/O瓶颈，但执行层（特别是Top-K选择和Join探针）的CPU成本在大规模下正成为新的瓶颈。本文提出了一种混合架构，通过选择性地仅将高影响力的基本操作卸载到GPU来增强现有的向量化执行。为了减少数据移动，我们使用仅键传输（键和指针）并配合延迟物化。我们进一步引入了风险门控（Risky Gate），该门控仅在基于输入大小、传输、内核和后处理成本以及候选集复杂度（K, M）的增益/风险区间内触发卸载。使用PostgreSQL微基准测试和GPU代理测量，我们观察到在门控卸载下，与始终开启的GPU卸载相比，尾部延迟（P95/P99）得到改善。这项工作将用于优化器阶段GPU辅助测量的风险感知门控原则（arXiv:2512.19750）扩展到了执行层的OLAP基本操作。
AI.summary: 该研究针对OLAP系统执行层中CPU成本成为新瓶颈的问题，提出了一种GPU增强的混合架构，通过选择性地将高影响力的原语卸载到GPU来加速执行。为减少数据移动开销，采用了键值仅传输和延迟物化技术。核心创新是引入了“风险门控”（Risky Gate），该机制基于多种成本因素（如输入大小、传输成本等）来智能地决定是否进行卸载，从而在实际测试中显著改善了尾部延迟。
AI.keywords: OLAP, GPU卸载, 矢量化执行, 风险门控, 尾部延迟
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个混合架构，仅将高影响力的原语卸载到GPU，并通过“风险门控”机制（Risky Gate）来智能地决定何时进行卸载，以最小化数据移动和计算开销。其重要性在于解决了CPU成为OLAP系统新瓶颈的问题。局限性是仅基于选定的基准测试和代理测量进行了验证。

title: Analysis of LLM Vulnerability to GPU Soft Errors: An Instruction-Level Fault Injection Study
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are highly compute- and memory-intensive, posing significant demands on high-performance GPUs. At the same time, advances in GPU technology driven by shrinking transistor sizes and lower operating voltages have made these devices increasingly susceptible to soft errors. While prior work has examined GPU reliability, most studies have focused on general-purpose applications or conventional neural networks mostly used for vision tasks such as classification and detection. In contrast, systematic analysis of modern large-scale LLMs remains limited, despite their rapid adoption in diverse application scenarios. Given the unique characteristics of LLMs, their resilience to soft errors may differ substantially from earlier models. To bridge this gap, we conduct the first instruction-level fault injection study of LLM inference. Our approach reveals reliability characteristics from multiple perspectives, highlighting the effects of model architecture, parameter scale, and task complexity. These findings provide new insights into LLM reliability and inform the design of more effective fault tolerance mechanisms.

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）对GPU软错误的脆弱性分析：一项指令级错误注入研究
AI.tldr: 研究人员首次对LLM推理过程进行了指令级软错误注入，发现LLM对GPU软错误的敏感性受模型架构、规模和任务复杂度影响，为设计LLM容错机制提供了新见解。
AI.motivation: LLM对高性能GPU的计算和内存需求巨大，而缩小晶体管尺寸和降低工作电压使得GPU更容易受到软错误的影响。现有对GPU可靠性的研究主要集中在通用应用或传统神经网络（如视觉任务），对现代大规模LLMs的系统性分析仍然有限，但LLM的特性可能使其对软错误的抵抗力有很大不同。
AI.method: 指令级别的错误注入研究。
AI.result: 研究揭示了从多个角度（包括模型架构、参数规模和任务复杂度）的可靠性特征。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为LLM的可靠性提供了新的见解，并为设计更有效的容错机制提供了信息。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）是高度计算和内存密集型的，对高性能GPU提出了巨大的需求。同时，由晶体管尺寸缩小和工作电压降低驱动的GPU技术进步使得这些设备越来越容易受到软错误的影响。虽然以往的工作已经检查了GPU的可靠性，但大多数研究都集中在通用应用程序或主要用于分类和检测等视觉任务的传统神经网络上。相比之下，尽管现代大型语言模型在各种应用场景中迅速普及，但对其进行系统的分析仍然有限。考虑到LLMs的独特特性，它们对软错误的抵抗力可能与早期模型有很大不同。为弥补这一差距，我们对LLM推理进行了首次指令级别的错误注入研究。我们的方法从多个角度揭示了可靠性特征，突出了模型架构、参数规模和任务复杂度的影响。这些发现为LLM的可靠性提供了新的见解，并为设计更有效的容错机制提供了信息。
AI.summary: 本研究首次对大型语言模型（LLM）的推理过程进行了指令级别的软错误注入分析，以探究其在GPU上运行时的可靠性。研究考察了模型架构、参数规模和任务复杂度对LLM容错能力的影响，旨在为LLM的可靠性设计提供新的见解和容错机制的参考。
AI.keywords: LLM, 软错误, GPU, 错误注入, 可靠性
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于首次针对大型语言模型（LLMs）的推理过程进行了指令级别的错误注入研究，这填补了现有研究主要集中在通用应用或传统视觉任务模型的空白。其重要性在于揭示了LLM特有的可靠性特征，为未来的容错机制设计提供了基础。局限性可能在于研究仅限于推理阶段，并未涵盖训练阶段。

title: From Intuition to Expertise: Rubric-Based Cognitive Calibration for Human Detection of LLM-Generated Korean Text
summary: Distinguishing human-written Korean text from fluent LLM outputs remains difficult even for linguistically trained readers, who can over-trust surface well-formedness. We study whether expert detection can be treated as a learnable skill and improved through structured calibration. We introduce LREAD, a rubric derived from national Korean writing standards and adapted to target micro-level artifacts (e.g., punctuation optionality, spacing behavior, and register shifts). In a three-phase longitudinal blind protocol with Korean linguistics majors, Phase 1 measures intuition-only detection, Phase 2 enforces criterion-level scoring with explicit justifications, and Phase 3 evaluates domain-focused mastery on held-out elementary essays. Across phases, majority-vote accuracy increases from 60% to 100%, accompanied by stronger inter-annotator agreement (Fleiss' kappa: -0.09 --> 0.82). Compared to state-of-the-art LLM detectors, calibrated humans rely more on language-specific micro-diagnostics that are not well captured by coarse discourse priors. Our findings suggest that rubric-scaffolded expert judgment can serve as an interpretable complement to automated detectors for non-English settings, and we release the full rubric and a taxonomy of calibrated detection signatures.

AI.title_translation: 从直觉到专业知识：基于评分标准的认知校准，用于人类检测大型语言模型生成的韩语文本
AI.tldr: 通过使用针对韩语微观特征（如标点、间距）设计的LREAD评分标准进行三阶段训练，韩国语言学专业学生检测LLM生成文本的准确率从60%飙升至100%，证明结构化校准能将人类直觉转化为可靠的专业技能，为自动化检测提供可解释的补充。
AI.motivation: 即使是受过语言训练的读者，区分人类撰写的韩语和流畅的LLM输出仍然很困难，因为他们可能会过度信赖表面上的流畅性。研究旨在探究专家检测是否可以被视为一种可学习的技能，并通过结构化校准来改进。
AI.method: 提出LREAD评分标准，该标准源自韩国国家写作标准并针对微观特征（如标点符号可选性、间距行为和语域转换）进行了调整。采用三阶段纵向盲法协议对韩国语言学专业学生进行测试：第一阶段仅凭直觉检测，第二阶段要求明确理由的评分，第三阶段评估对初级作文的掌握程度。
AI.result: 在三个阶段中，多数投票的准确率从60%提高到100%，同时注释者间一致性（Fleiss' kappa）也显著增强（从-0.09提高到0.82）。与最先进的LLM检测器相比，经过校准的人类专家更依赖于自动化模型难以捕捉的特定语言微观诊断特征。
AI.conclusion: 基于标准的评分制度（rubric-scaffolded expert judgment）可以作为自动化检测器的可解释补充，特别适用于非英语环境，因为它能引导人类专家关注自动化模型可能忽略的特定语言微观诊断特征。
AI.translation: 区分人类撰写的韩语文本和流畅的LLM输出对即使是受过语言训练的读者来说仍然很困难，他们可能会过度信赖表面上的完好性。我们研究专家检测是否可以被视为一种可学习的技能，并通过结构化校准来改进。我们引入了LREAD，这是一个源自国家韩语写作标准并针对微观层面的人工制品（例如，标点符号的可选性、间距行为和语域转换）进行调整的评分标准。在与韩国语言学专业学生进行的三阶段纵向盲法协议中，第一阶段衡量仅凭直觉的检测，第二阶段强制要求明确的理由进行标准级评分，第三阶段评估对保留的小学作文的领域重点掌握程度。在各个阶段中，多数投票的准确率从60%提高到100%，同时注释者间一致性（Fleiss' kappa：-0.09 --> 0.82）也得到加强。与最先进的LLM检测器相比，经过校准的人类更依赖于自动化模型难以捕捉的特定于语言的微观诊断。我们的研究结果表明，基于评分标准的专家判断可以作为自动化检测器在非英语环境下的可解释补充，我们发布了完整的评分标准和校准检测特征的分类法。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为LREAD的、基于韩国国家写作标准的评分标准，用于结构化校准人类专家对大型语言模型（LLM）生成韩语文本的检测能力。通过三阶段实验，专家检测准确率从60%显著提升至100%，一致性也大幅提高。研究表明，这种基于评分标准的专家判断可以作为自动化检测器在非英语场景下的有效补充。
AI.keywords: LLM检测, 认知校准, 评分标准, 韩国语, 人类专家
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将人类对LLM生成文本的检测视为一种可学习的技能，并通过基于国家标准制定的、针对微观层面的评分标准（LREAD）进行结构化校准，显著提高了检测的准确性和一致性。其重要性在于为非英语环境中自动化检测器的不足提供了可解释的补充方案。局限性可能在于研究对象仅限于韩国语言学专业学生。

title: Simulating Complex Multi-Turn Tool Calling Interactions in Stateless Execution Environments
summary: Synthetic data has proven itself to be a valuable resource for tuning smaller, cost-effective language models to handle the complexities of multi-turn tool calling conversations. While many frameworks and systems for producing synthetic multi-turn tool calling data have been proposed, prior works have frequently assumed that any tool calling interactions will take place in an execution environment that maintains state. When such an environment is available, this is advantageous as it allows for the validity of an interaction to be determined by whether or not the state of the execution environment matches to some prespecified objective. Unfortunately, this does not hold in many real-world tool use settings, e.g., in enterprise settings where data security is of the utmost importance or in cases where tool specifications are synthesized from multiple sources. In this work, we address this gap by introducing a data generation method, DiGiT-TC, that is designed to produce tool calling conversations that have the characteristics of conversations generated through search in a stateful environment. The key to our technique lies in a novel generation pattern that allows our approach to implicitly represent certain tool calls in the user request. We validate our approach on standard tool calling benchmarks and demonstrate that, even in stateful problem settings, our approach results in strong performance gains.

AI.title_translation: 在无状态执行环境中模拟复杂的、多轮的工具调用交互
AI.tldr: 提出 DiGiT-TC 方法，用于在不维护状态的环境中生成复杂的多轮工具调用对话数据，解决了现有方法对有状态环境的依赖问题，并在测试中表现出色。
AI.motivation: 现有用于生成合成多轮工具调用数据的框架通常假设工具调用交互发生在维护状态的执行环境中，但这不适用于许多现实世界的工具使用场景，例如数据安全至关重要的企业环境或工具规范来自多个来源的情况。
AI.method: 引入了一种名为 DiGiT-TC 的数据生成方法，其核心在于一种新颖的生成模式，允许方法隐式地在用户请求中表示某些工具调用，从而模拟有状态环境下的交互特征。
AI.result: 在标准工具调用基准测试上验证了该方法，并证明了即使在有状态问题设置中，该方法也能带来强劲的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 我们验证了该方法在标准工具调用基准测试上的有效性，并证明了即使在有状态问题设置中，我们提出的方法也能带来显著的性能提升。
AI.translation: 合成数据已被证明是调整较小、更具成本效益的语言模型以处理复杂的多轮工具调用对话的宝贵资源。虽然已经提出了许多用于生成合成多轮工具调用数据的框架和系统，但先前的工作通常假设任何工具调用交互都将发生在维护状态的执行环境中。当存在这样的环境时，这是有利的，因为它允许通过执行环境的状态是否与预先指定的某个目标相匹配来确定交互的有效性。不幸的是，这在许多现实世界的工具使用场景中并不成立，例如在数据安全至关重要的企业环境中，或在工具规范从多个来源合成的情况下。在这项工作中，我们通过引入一种数据生成方法 DiGiT-TC 来解决这一差距，该方法旨在生成具有通过状态环境中的搜索生成的对话特征的工具调用对话。我们技术的关键在于一种新颖的生成模式，它允许我们的方法在用户请求中隐式地表示某些工具调用。我们在标准工具调用基准测试上验证了我们的方法，并证明了即使在有状态问题设置中，我们产生的方法也能带来强劲的性能提升。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有合成多轮工具调用数据生成方法依赖于有状态执行环境的局限性，提出了一种名为 DiGiT-TC 的新数据生成方法。DiGiT-TC 采用新颖的生成模式，能够在无状态环境中生成具有有状态交互特征的工具调用对话，并在标准基准测试上取得了优异性能。
AI.keywords: 合成数据, 多轮工具调用, 无状态执行环境, 数据生成, DiGiT-TC
AI.comments: 该工作创新性地解决了在无状态环境中模拟复杂多轮工具调用交互的难题，这在数据安全或工具规范分散的实际场景中尤为重要。其核心在于引入了一种新颖的生成模式。

title: Modeling Next-Token Prediction as Left-Nested Intuitionistic Implication
summary:
We introduce the \emph{Arrow Language Model}, a neural architecture derived from an intuitionistic-logic interpretation of next-token prediction. Instead of representing tokens as additive embeddings mixed by attention, we encode a prefix as a \emph{left-nested implication chain} whose structure preserves order through non-commutative composition. Next-token prediction corresponds to \emph{modus ponens}, and sequence processing becomes constructive proof extension under the Curry--Howard correspondence. Our Prolog-based specialized theorem provers validate fundamental properties of the neural models, among which relations between commutative vs. non-commutative sequencing and single-token vs. multi-token prediction choices. We show that a neural architecture equivalent to multiplicative RNNs arises naturally from a proof-theoretic interpretation of next-token prediction as nested intuitionistic implication, we present a practical low-rank neural realization and position the model relative to Transformers and state-space models.
  Keywords: logic-based derivation of neural architectures, intuitionistic implicational logic, token-as-operator neural models, state-space models, alternatives to transformer-based foundational models.

AI.title_translation: 将下一个词预测建模为左嵌套直觉蕴涵
AI.tldr: 研究人员将下一个词预测重新概念化为直觉逻辑中的左嵌套蕴涵链（基于Curry-Howard对应关系），这自然地产生了一种等价于乘法RNN的神经模型，并提供了一种替代Transformer的架构。
AI.motivation: 从直觉逻辑的角度对下一个词预测进行建模，以探索与现有基于注意力的嵌入混合方法不同的序列表示和处理方式，特别是通过利用非交换组合来保留顺序。
AI.method: 引入了“箭头语言模型”（Arrow Language Model），这是一种源于下一个词预测的直觉逻辑解释的神经架构。它将前缀编码为一个“左嵌套蕴涵链”，该结构通过非交换组合保留顺序。下一个词预测对应于“肯定前件”（modus ponens），序列处理则对应于Curry-Howard对应关系下的构造性证明扩展。使用基于Prolog的专用定理证明器来验证模型的属性。
AI.result: 证明了源于嵌套直觉蕴涵的证明论解释自然地产生了等同于乘法RNN的神经架构。使用Prolog定理证明器验证了模型属性，例如关于可交换/非交换序列和单/多词预测选择之间的关系。提出了一个实际的低秩神经实现。
AI.conclusion: 从证明论的角度解释下一个词预测为嵌套直觉蕴涵，自然地产生了一个等同于乘法RNN的神经架构。我们提出了一个实际的低秩神经实现，并将该模型与Transformer和状态空间模型进行了比较。
AI.translation: 我们引入了“箭头语言模型”，这是一种源于下一个词预测的直觉逻辑解释的神经架构。与通过注意力混合的加性嵌入表示词元不同，我们将前缀编码为一个“左嵌套蕴涵链”，其结构通过非交换组合保留顺序。下一个词预测对应于“肯定前件”（modus ponens），序列处理则对应于Curry-Howard对应关系下的构造性证明扩展。基于Prolog的专用定理证明器验证了神经模型的基本属性，其中包括关于可交换与非交换序列化以及单词与多词预测选择之间的关系。我们表明，源于将下一个词预测解释为嵌套直觉蕴涵的证明论解释，自然地产生了一个等同于乘法RNN的神经架构，我们提出了一个实际的低秩神经实现，并将该模型置于Transformer和状态空间模型的相对位置。
AI.summary: 本文提出了“箭头语言模型”，这是一种受下一个词预测的直觉逻辑解释启发的神经架构。它将前缀编码为保留顺序的左嵌套蕴涵链，其中下一个词预测等同于肯定前件（modus ponens），序列处理等同于构造性证明扩展。研究结果表明，这种方法自然地导出了一个等价于乘法RNN的架构，并提出了一个低秩实现，同时将该模型与Transformer和状态空间模型进行了比较。
AI.keywords: 逻辑驱动的神经架构推导, 直觉蕴涵逻辑, 词元即算子神经模型, 状态空间模型, Transformer基础模型的替代方案
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将下一个词预测建模为一个基于直觉主义逻辑的左嵌套蕴涵链，这提供了一种与现有基于注意力的模型完全不同的序列处理视角。其重要性在于，它通过Curry-Howard对应关系，将序列处理与构造性证明扩展联系起来，并展示了与乘法RNN的理论等价性。局限性可能在于其实际性能与最先进的Transformer模型相比如何，以及其“低秩神经实现”的效率和扩展性。

title: PaperAudit-Bench: Benchmarking Error Detection in Research Papers for Critical Automated Peer Review
summary: Large language models can generate fluent peer reviews, yet their assessments often lack sufficient critical rigor when substantive issues are subtle and distributed across a paper. In this paper, we introduce PaperAudit-Bench, which consists of two components: (1) PaperAudit-Dataset, an error dataset covering both errors identifiable within individual sections and those requiring cross-section reasoning, designed for controlled evaluation under long-context settings; and (2) PaperAudit-Review, an automated review framework that integrates structured error detection with evidence-aware review generation to support critical assessment. Experiments on PaperAudit-Bench reveal large variability in error detectability across models and detection depths, highlighting the difficulty of identifying such errors under long-context settings. Relative to representative automated reviewing baselines, incorporating explicit error detection into the review workflow produces systematically stricter and more discriminative evaluations, demonstrating its suitability for peer review. Finally, we show that the dataset supports training lightweight LLM detectors via SFT and RL, enabling effective error detection at reduced computational cost.

AI.title_translation: PaperAudit-Bench：为关键的自动化同行评审基准测试研究论文中的错误检测
AI.tldr: 研究人员创建了一个名为PaperAudit-Bench的新基准和框架，用于测试大型语言模型识别研究论文中微妙错误的程度。结果显示，直接集成错误检测步骤能使AI评审更严格，并且可以使用该基准来训练更小的、更高效的错误检测模型。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型生成的同行评审评论虽然流畅，但在实质性问题细微且分散于论文各处时，其批判性严谨性往往不足。
AI.method: PaperAudit-Bench由两部分组成：(1) PaperAudit-Dataset，一个涵盖局部和跨章节错误的数据集，用于长上下文设置下的受控评估；(2) PaperAudit-Review，一个整合了结构化错误检测和证据感知评论生成的自动化评论框架。
AI.result: 在PaperAudit-Bench上的实验表明，不同模型在错误可检测性和检测深度上存在巨大差异，凸显了在长上下文设置下识别此类错误的难度。与代表性的自动化评审基线相比，纳入明确的错误检测流程可以系统性地产生更严格和更具区分性的评估。
AI.conclusion: 将明确的错误检测集成到审查工作流程中可以产生系统上更严格和更具区分性的评估，证明了其对同行评审的适用性。此外，该数据集支持通过SFT和RL训练轻量级LLM检测器，从而以降低的计算成本实现有效的错误检测。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型可以生成流畅的同行评审，但当实质性问题细微且分布在论文各处时，它们的评估往往缺乏足够的批判性严谨性。在本文中，我们介绍了PaperAudit-Bench，它由两个组成部分构成：(1) PaperAudit-Dataset，一个涵盖可在单个章节内识别的错误和需要跨章节推理的错误的错误数据集，旨在用于长上下文设置下的受控评估；和 (2) PaperAudit-Review，一个整合了结构化错误检测和证据感知评论生成的自动化评审框架，以支持批判性评估。在PaperAudit-Bench上的实验揭示了错误可检测性在模型和检测深度上存在巨大差异，突显了在长上下文设置下识别此类错误的难度。与代表性的自动化评审基线相比，将明确的错误检测纳入评审工作流程可以系统性地产生更严格和更具区分性的评估，证明了其对同行评审的适用性。最后，我们表明该数据集支持通过SFT和RL训练轻量级LLM检测器，从而以降低的计算成本实现有效的错误检测。
AI.summary: 本文提出了PaperAudit-Bench，一个用于基准测试研究论文中错误检测的框架，以提高自动化同行评审的批判性。该基准包含一个错误数据集（PaperAudit-Dataset）和一种自动化评审框架（PaperAudit-Review），实验证明了集成明确的错误检测能使评估更严格，并且该数据集可用于训练轻量级错误检测模型。
AI.keywords: 自动化同行评审, 错误检测, 长上下文, LLM, 评估基准
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于构建了一个同时包含局部错误和跨章节错误的新型基准（PaperAudit-Bench），并提出了一种整合了错误检测和证据感知生成（PaperAudit-Review）的自动化同行评审框架，解决了现有LLM在识别细微、分布式错误方面的不足。其重要性在于推动了自动化同行评审的深度和严格性。局限性是仅基于现有论文的错误进行评估，未提及对新颖性或科学价值的评估。

title: PILOT: Planning via Internalized Latent Optimization Trajectories for Large Language Models
summary: Strategic planning is critical for multi-step reasoning, yet compact Large Language Models (LLMs) often lack the capacity to formulate global strategies, leading to error propagation in long-horizon tasks. Our analysis reveals that LLMs possess latent reasoning capabilities that can be unlocked when conditioned on explicit plans from a teacher model; however, runtime reliance on external guidance is often impractical due to latency and availability constraints. To bridge this gap, we propose PILOT (Planning via Internalized Latent Optimization Trajectories), a non-invasive framework designed to internalize the strategic oversight of large models into intrinsic Latent Guidance. Instead of altering backbone weights, PILOT employs a lightweight Hyper-Network to synthesize a query-conditioned Latent Guidance vector. This vector acts as an internal steering mechanism, guiding the model's representations toward optimal reasoning paths. Extensive experiments on mathematical and coding benchmarks demonstrate that PILOT effectively stabilizes reasoning trajectories, consistently outperforming strong baselines (e.g., +8.9% on MATH500) with negligible inference latency.

title: Lowest Span Confidence: A Zero-Shot Metric for Efficient and Black-Box Hallucination Detection in LLMs
summary: Hallucinations in Large Language Models (LLMs), i.e., the tendency to generate plausible but non-factual content, pose a significant challenge for their reliable deployment in high-stakes environments. However, existing hallucination detection methods generally operate under unrealistic assumptions, i.e., either requiring expensive intensive sampling strategies for consistency checks or white-box LLM states, which are unavailable or inefficient in common API-based scenarios. To this end, we propose a novel efficient zero-shot metric called Lowest Span Confidence (LSC) for hallucination detection under minimal resource assumptions, only requiring a single forward with output probabilities. Concretely, LSC evaluates the joint likelihood of semantically coherent spans via a sliding window mechanism. By identifying regions of lowest marginal confidence across variable-length n-grams, LSC could well capture local uncertainty patterns strongly correlated with factual inconsistency. Importantly, LSC can mitigate the dilution effect of perplexity and the noise sensitivity of minimum token probability, offering a more robust estimate of factual uncertainty. Extensive experiments across multiple state-of-the-art (SOTA) LLMs and diverse benchmarks show that LSC consistently outperforms existing zero-shot baselines, delivering strong detection performance even under resource-constrained conditions.

title: FastWhisper: Adaptive Self-knowledge Distillation for Real-time Automatic Speech Recognition
summary: Knowledge distillation is one of the most effective methods for model compression. Previous studies have focused on the student model effectively training the predictive distribution of the teacher model. However, during training, the student model may inherit the shortcomings of the teacher model, which can lead to a decline in generalization capacity. To mitigate this issue, we propose adaptive self-knowledge distillation (ASKD), which dynamically reduces the dependence of the teacher model to improve the self-training capacity, and performs the self-knowledge distillation method to improve the generalization capacity of the student model. We further distill the Whisper model into a smaller variant, called FastWhisper. In our post-training setting, FastWhisper achieved a word error rate of 1.07% lower than the teacher model Whisper, and its relative inference time was 5 times faster.

title: PiC-BNN: A 128-kbit 65 nm Processing-in-CAM-Based End-to-End Binary Neural Network Accelerator
comments: 7 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to IEEE CCMCC 2025
summary: Binary Neural Networks (BNNs), where weights and activations are constrained to binary values (+1, -1), are a highly efficient alternative to traditional neural networks. Unfortunately, typical BNNs, while binarizing linear layers (matrix-vector multiplication), still implement other network layers (batch normalization, softmax, output layer, and sometimes the input layer of a convolutional neural network) in full precision. This limits the area and energy benefits and requires architectural support for full precision operations. We propose PiC-BNN, a true end-to-end binary in-approximate search (Hamming distance tolerant) Content Addressable Memory based BNN accelerator. PiC-BNN is designed and manufactured in a commercial 65nm process. PiC-BNN uses Hamming distance tolerance to apply the law of large numbers to enable accurate classification without implementing full precision operations. PiC-BNN achieves baseline software accuracy (95.2%) on the MNIST dataset and 93.5% on the Hand Gesture (HG) dataset, a throughput of 560K inferences/s, and presents a power efficiency of 703M inferences/s/W when implementing a binary MLP model for MNIST/HG dataset classification.
comment: 7 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to IEEE CCMCC 2025

title: Demystifying Multi-Agent Debate: The Role of Confidence and Diversity
summary: Multi-agent debate (MAD) is widely used to improve large language model (LLM) performance through test-time scaling, yet recent work shows that vanilla MAD often underperforms simple majority vote despite higher computational cost. Studies show that, under homogeneous agents and uniform belief updates, debate preserves expected correctness and therefore cannot reliably improve outcomes. Drawing on findings from human deliberation and collective decision-making, we identify two key mechanisms missing from vanilla MAD: (i) diversity of initial viewpoints and (ii) explicit, calibrated confidence communication. We propose two lightweight interventions. First, a diversity-aware initialisation that selects a more diverse pool of candidate answers, increasing the likelihood that a correct hypothesis is present at the start of debate. Second, a confidence-modulated debate protocol in which agents express calibrated confidence and condition their updates on others' confidence. We show theoretically that diversity-aware initialisation improves the prior probability of MAD success without changing the underlying update dynamics, while confidence-modulated updates enable debate to systematically drift to the correct hypothesis. Empirically, across six reasoning-oriented QA benchmarks, our methods consistently outperform vanilla MAD and majority vote. Our results connect human deliberation with LLM-based debate and demonstrate that simple, principled modifications can substantially enhance debate effectiveness.

title: HEART: A Unified Benchmark for Assessing Humans and LLMs in Emotional Support Dialogue
summary: Supportive conversation depends on skills that go beyond language fluency, including reading emotions, adjusting tone, and navigating moments of resistance, frustration, or distress. Despite rapid progress in language models, we still lack a clear way to understand how their abilities in these interpersonal domains compare to those of humans. We introduce HEART, the first-ever framework that directly compares humans and LLMs on the same multi-turn emotional-support conversations. For each dialogue history, we pair human and model responses and evaluate them through blinded human raters and an ensemble of LLM-as-judge evaluators. All assessments follow a rubric grounded in interpersonal communication science across five dimensions: Human Alignment, Empathic Responsiveness, Attunement, Resonance, and Task-Following. HEART uncovers striking behavioral patterns. Several frontier models approach or surpass the average human responses in perceived empathy and consistency. At the same time, humans maintain advantages in adaptive reframing, tension-naming, and nuanced tone shifts, particularly in adversarial turns. Human and LLM-as-judge preferences align on about 80 percent of pairwise comparisons, matching inter-human agreement, and their written rationales emphasize similar HEART dimensions. This pattern suggests an emerging convergence in the criteria used to assess supportive quality. By placing humans and models on equal footing, HEART reframes supportive dialogue as a distinct capability axis, separable from general reasoning or linguistic fluency. It provides a unified empirical foundation for understanding where model-generated support aligns with human social judgment, where it diverges, and how affective conversational competence scales with model size.

title: Table-BiEval: A Self-Supervised, Dual-Track Framework for Decoupling Structure and Content in LLM Evaluation
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) evolve into autonomous agents, the capability to faithfully translate natural language into rigorous structured formats-essential for tool invocation-and to convert complex tabular information into machine-readable specifications has become paramount. However, current evaluations lack effective methodologies to measure this structural fidelity without costly human intervention, as traditional text metrics fail to detect semantic drift in code-like outputs. This paper proposes Table-BiEval, a novel approach based on a human-free, self-supervised evaluation framework, to assess LLMs performance quantitatively. By leveraging deterministic Intermediate Representations, our framework calculates Content Semantic Accuracy and Normalized Tree Edit Distance to decouple structure from content. Also, it empirically evaluates 15 state-of-the-art LLMs across dual topological dimensions-hierarchical structures and flat tables. The results reveal substantial variability, highlighting that mid-sized models can surprisingly outperform larger counterparts in structural efficiency and confirming that deep recursive nesting remains a universal bottleneck for current architectures.

title: OPT-Engine: Benchmarking the Limits of LLMs in Optimization Modeling via Complexity Scaling
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive progress in optimization modeling, fostering a rapid expansion of new methodologies and evaluation benchmarks. However, the boundaries of their capabilities in automated formulation and problem solving remain poorly understood, particularly when extending to complex, real-world tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose OPT-ENGINE, an extensible benchmark framework designed to evaluate LLMs on optimization modeling with controllable and scalable difficulty levels. OPT-ENGINE spans 10 canonical tasks across operations research, with five Linear Programming and five Mixed-Integer Programming. Utilizing OPT-ENGINE, we conduct an extensive study of LLMs' reasoning capabilities, addressing two critical questions: 1.) Do LLMs' performance remain robust when generalizing to out-of-distribution optimization tasks that scale in complexity beyond current benchmark levels? and 2.) At what stage, from problem interpretation to solution generation, do current LLMs encounter the most significant bottlenecks? Our empirical results yield two key insights: first, tool-integrated reasoning with external solvers exhibits significantly higher robustness as task complexity escalates, while pure-text reasoning reaches a ceiling; second, the automated formulation of constraints constitutes the primary performance bottleneck. These findings provide actionable guidance for developing next-generation LLMs for advanced optimization. Our code is publicly available at \textcolor{blue}{https://github.com/Cardinal-Operations/OPTEngine}.

title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Abstract Evaluation Tasks: An Empirical Study
summary: Introduction: Large language models (LLMs) can process requests and generate texts, but their feasibility for assessing complex academic content needs further investigation. To explore LLM's potential in assisting scientific review, this study examined ChatGPT-5, Gemini-3-Pro, and Claude-Sonnet-4.5's consistency and reliability in evaluating abstracts compared to one another and to human reviewers. Methods: 160 abstracts from a local conference were graded by human reviewers and three LLMs using one rubric. Composite score distributions across three LLMs and fourteen reviewers were examined. Inter-rater reliability was calculated using intraclass correlation coefficients (ICCs) for within-AI reliability and AI-human concordance. Bland-Altman plots were examined for visual agreement patterns and systematic bias. Results: LLMs achieved good-to-excellent agreement with each other (ICCs: 0.59-0.87). ChatGPT and Claude reached moderate agreement with human reviewers on overall quality and content-specific criteria, with ICCs ~.45-.60 for composite, impression, clarity, objective, and results. They exhibited fair agreement on subjective dimensions, with ICC ranging from 0.23-0.38 for impact, engagement, and applicability. Gemini showed fair agreement on half criteria and no reliability on impact and applicability. Three LLMs showed acceptable or negligible mean difference (ChatGPT=0.24, Gemini=0.42, Claude=-0.02) from the human mean composite scores. Discussion: LLMs could process abstracts in batches with moderate agreement with human experts on overall quality and objective criteria. With appropriate process architecture, they can apply a rubric consistently across volumes of abstracts exceeding feasibility for a human rater. The weaker performance on subjective dimensions indicates that AI should serve a complementary role in evaluation, while human expertise remains essential.

title: The Grammar of Transformers: A Systematic Review of Interpretability Research on Syntactic Knowledge in Language Models
summary: We present a systematic review of 337 articles evaluating the syntactic abilities of Transformer-based language models, reporting on 1,015 model results from a range of syntactic phenomena and interpretability methods. Our analysis shows that the state of the art presents a healthy variety of methods and data, but an over-focus on a single language (English), a single model (BERT), and phenomena that are easy to get at (like part of speech and agreement). Results also suggest that TLMs capture these form-oriented phenomena well, but show more variable and weaker performance on phenomena at the syntax-semantics interface, like binding or filler-gap dependencies. We provide recommendations for future work, in particular reporting complete data, better aligning theoretical constructs and methods across studies, increasing the use of mechanistic methods, and broadening the empirical scope regarding languages and linguistic phenomena.

title: Attribution Techniques for Mitigating Hallucinated Information in RAG Systems: A Survey
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs)-based question answering (QA) systems play a critical role in modern AI, demonstrating strong performance across various tasks. However, LLM-generated responses often suffer from hallucinations, unfaithful statements lacking reliable references. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks enhance LLM responses by incorporating external references but also introduce new forms of hallucination due to complex interactions between the retriever and generator. To address these challenges, researchers have explored attribution-based techniques that ensure responses are verifiably supported by retrieved content. Despite progress, a unified pipeline for these techniques, along with a clear taxonomy and systematic comparison of their strengths and weaknesses, remains lacking. A well-defined taxonomy is essential for identifying specific failure modes within RAG systems, while comparative analysis helps practitioners choose appropriate solutions based on hallucination types and application context. This survey investigates how attribution-based techniques are used within RAG systems to mitigate hallucinations and addresses the gap by: (i) outlining a taxonomy of hallucination types in RAG systems, (ii) presenting a unified pipeline for attribution techniques, (iii) reviewing techniques based on the hallucinations they target, and (iv) discussing strengths and weaknesses with practical guidelines. This work offers insights for future research and practical use of attribution techniques in RAG systems.

title: Towards a Mechanistic Understanding of Large Reasoning Models: A Survey of Training, Inference, and Failures
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has catalyzed the emergence of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) that have pushed reasoning capabilities to new heights. While their performance has garnered significant excitement, exploring the internal mechanisms driving these behaviors has become an equally critical research frontier. This paper provides a comprehensive survey of the mechanistic understanding of LRMs, organizing recent findings into three core dimensions: 1) training dynamics, 2) reasoning mechanisms, and 3) unintended behaviors. By synthesizing these insights, we aim to bridge the gap between black-box performance and mechanistic transparency. Finally, we discuss under-explored challenges to outline a roadmap for future mechanistic studies, including the need for applied interpretability, improved methodologies, and a unified theoretical framework.

title: Stingy Context: 18:1 Hierarchical Code Compression for LLM Auto-Coding
summary: We introduce Stingy Context, a hierarchical tree-based compression scheme achieving 18:1 reduction in LLM context for auto-coding tasks. Using our TREEFRAG exploit decomposition, we reduce a real source code base of 239k tokens to 11k tokens while preserving task fidelity. Empirical results across 12 Frontier models show 94 to 97% success on 40 real-world issues at low cost, outperforming flat methods and mitigating lost-in-the-middle effects.

title: SDUs DAISY: A Benchmark for Danish Culture
comments: Danish Culture Benchmark, 2 Tables, 1 Figure demonstrating the data curation pipeline
summary: We introduce a new benchmark for Danish culture via cultural heritage, Daisy, based on the curated topics from the Danish Culture Canon 2006. For each artifact in the culture canon, we query the corresponding Wikipedia page and have a language model generate random questions. This yields a sampling strategy within each work, with a mix of central of peripheral questions for each work, not only knowledge of mainstream information, but also in-depth cornerstones defining the heritage of Danish Culture, defined by the Canon committee. Each question-answer pair is humanly approved or corrected in the final dataset consisting of 741 close-ended question answer pairs covering topics, from 1300 BC. archaeological findings, 1700 century poems and musicals pieces to contemporary pop music and Danish design and architecture.
comment: Danish Culture Benchmark, 2 Tables, 1 Figure demonstrating the data curation pipeline

title: CascadeMind at SemEval-2026 Task 4: A Hybrid Neuro-Symbolic Cascade for Narrative Similarity
comments: 6 pages (including references), 2 figures, 2 tables. System description paper for SemEval-2026 Task 4 (Narrative Story Similarity)
summary: We present a hybrid neuro-symbolic system for the SemEval-2026 Task 4 on Narrative Story Similarity. Our approach combines neural self-consistency voting with a novel Multi-Scale Narrative Analysis Ensemble that operates as a symbolic tiebreaker. The neural network component uses a large language model with multiple parallel votes, applying a supermajority threshold for confident decisions and escalating uncertain cases to additional voting rounds. When votes result in a perfect tie, a symbolic ensemble combining five narrative similarity signals (lexical overlap, semantic embeddings, story grammar structure, event chain alignment, and narrative tension curves) provides the final decision. Our cascade architecture achieves 81% accuracy on the development set, demonstrating that selective deferral to symbolic methods can enhance neural predictions on genuinely ambiguous narrative comparisons.
comment: 6 pages (including references), 2 figures, 2 tables. System description paper for SemEval-2026 Task 4 (Narrative Story Similarity)

title: "Newspaper Eat" Means "Not Tasty": A Taxonomy and Benchmark for Coded Languages in Real-World Chinese Online Reviews
summary: Coded language is an important part of human communication. It refers to cases where users intentionally encode meaning so that the surface text differs from the intended meaning and must be decoded to be understood. Current language models handle coded language poorly. Progress has been limited by the lack of real-world datasets and clear taxonomies. This paper introduces CodedLang, a dataset of 7,744 Chinese Google Maps reviews, including 900 reviews with span-level annotations of coded language. We developed a seven-class taxonomy that captures common encoding strategies, including phonetic, orthographic, and cross-lingual substitutions. We benchmarked language models on coded language detection, classification, and review rating prediction. Results show that even strong models can fail to identify or understand coded language. Because many coded expressions rely on pronunciation-based strategies, we further conducted a phonetic analysis of coded and decoded forms. Together, our results highlight coded language as an important and underexplored challenge for real-world NLP systems.

title: Text-to-State Mapping for Non-Resolution Reasoning: The Contradiction-Preservation Principle
comments: 17 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Sequel to arXiv:2512.13478
summary: Non-Resolution Reasoning (NRR) provides a formal framework for maintaining semantic ambiguity rather than forcing premature interpretation collapse. While the foundational architecture establishes state spaces and operators for ambiguity-preserving computation, the critical question of how natural language maps to these mathematical structures remains open. This paper introduces the text-to-state mapping function φ that transforms linguistic input into superposition states within the NRR framework. We formalize the Contradiction-Preservation Principle, which requires that genuinely ambiguous expressions maintain non-zero entropy in their state representations, and develop extraction protocols using existing Large Language Models as interpretation generators. Empirical validation across 68 test sentences spanning lexical, structural, and pragmatic ambiguity demonstrates that our mapping achieves mean Shannon entropy H(S) = 1.087 bits for ambiguous inputs while baseline single-interpretation approaches yield H(S) = 0.000. The framework provides the missing algorithmic bridge between raw text and the formal state spaces on which NRR operators act, enabling architectural collapse deferment in language model inference.
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Sequel to arXiv:2512.13478

title: Quantifying non deterministic drift in large language models
comments: 10 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Empirical measurement study reporting new repeated-run experiments quantifying baseline nondeterministic drift in large language models. This manuscript presents original empirical results (not a review or position paper) and establishes a baseline reference for future drift-mitigation work
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used for tasks ranging from summarisation to decision support. In practice, identical prompts do not always produce identical outputs, even when temperature and other decoding parameters are fixed. In this work, we conduct repeated-run experiments to empirically quantify baseline behavioural drift, defined as output variability observed when the same prompt is issued multiple times under operator-free conditions. We evaluate two publicly accessible models, gpt-4o-mini and llama3.1-8b, across five prompt categories using exact repeats, perturbed inputs, and reuse modes at temperatures of 0.0 and 0.7. Drift is measured using unique output fractions, lexical similarity, and word count statistics, enabling direct comparison across models, prompting modes, and deployment types. The results show that nondeterminism persists even at temperature 0.0, with distinct variability patterns by model size, deployment, and prompt type. We situate these findings within existing work on concept drift, behavioural drift, and infrastructure-induced nondeterminism, discuss the limitations of lexical metrics, and highlight emerging semantic approaches. By establishing a systematic empirical baseline in the absence of stabilisation techniques, this study provides a reference point for evaluating future drift mitigation and control methods.
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Empirical measurement study reporting new repeated-run experiments quantifying baseline nondeterministic drift in large language models. This manuscript presents original empirical results (not a review or position paper) and establishes a baseline reference for future drift-mitigation work

title: Mem2ActBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Long-Term Memory Utilization in Task-Oriented Autonomous Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly deployed for complex, tool-based tasks where long-term memory is critical to driving actions. Existing benchmarks, however, primarily test a angent's ability to passively retrieve isolated facts in response to explicit questions. They fail to evaluate the more crucial capability of actively applying memory to execute tasks. To address this gap, we introduce \textsc{Mem2ActBench}, a benchmark for evaluating whether agents can proactively leverage long-term memory to execute tool-based actions by selecting appropriate tools and grounding their parameters. The benchmark simulates persistent assistant usage, where users mention the same topic across long, interrupted interactions and expect previously established preferences and task states to be implicitly applied. We build the dataset with an automated pipeline that merges heterogeneous sources (ToolACE, BFCL, Oasst1), resolves conflicts via consistency modeling, and synthesizes 2,029 sessions with 12 user--assistant--tool turns on average. From these memory chains, a reverse-generation method produces 400 tool-use tasks, with human evaluation confirming 91.3\% are strongly memory-dependent. Experiments on seven memory frameworks show that current systems remain inadequate at actively utilizing memory for parameter grounding, highlighting the need for more effective approaches to evaluate and improve memory application in task execution.

title: Gap-K%: Measuring Top-1 Prediction Gap for Detecting Pretraining Data
summary: The opacity of massive pretraining corpora in Large Language Models (LLMs) raises significant privacy and copyright concerns, making pretraining data detection a critical challenge. Existing state-of-the-art methods typically rely on token likelihoods, yet they often overlook the divergence from the model's top-1 prediction and local correlation between adjacent tokens. In this work, we propose Gap-K%, a novel pretraining data detection method grounded in the optimization dynamics of LLM pretraining. By analyzing the next-token prediction objective, we observe that discrepancies between the model's top-1 prediction and the target token induce strong gradient signals, which are explicitly penalized during training. Motivated by this, Gap-K% leverages the log probability gap between the top-1 predicted token and the target token, incorporating a sliding window strategy to capture local correlations and mitigate token-level fluctuations. Extensive experiments on the WikiMIA and MIMIR benchmarks demonstrate that Gap-K% achieves state-of-the-art performance, consistently outperforming prior baselines across various model sizes and input lengths.

title: DecHW: Heterogeneous Decentralized Federated Learning Exploiting Second-Order Information
comments: Funding: SoBigDatait (PNRR IR0000013), FAIR (PNRR PE00000013), RESTART (PNRR PE00000001)
summary: Decentralized Federated Learning (DFL) is a serverless collaborative machine learning paradigm where devices collaborate directly with neighbouring devices to exchange model information for learning a generalized model. However, variations in individual experiences and different levels of device interactions lead to data and model initialization heterogeneities across devices. Such heterogeneities leave variations in local model parameters across devices that leads to slower convergence. This paper tackles the data and model heterogeneity by explicitly addressing the parameter level varying evidential credence across local models. A novel aggregation approach is introduced that captures these parameter variations in local models and performs robust aggregation of neighbourhood local updates. Specifically, consensus weights are generated via approximation of second-order information of local models on their local datasets. These weights are utilized to scale neighbourhood updates before aggregating them into global neighbourhood representation. In extensive experiments with computer vision tasks, the proposed approach shows strong generalizability of local models at reduced communication costs.
comment: Funding: SoBigDatait (PNRR IR0000013), FAIR (PNRR PE00000013), RESTART (PNRR PE00000001)

AI.title_translation: DecHW：利用二阶信息的异构去中心化联邦学习
AI.tldr: DecHW是一种新的去中心化联邦学习（DFL）方法，它利用对二阶信息的近似来生成共识权重。这些权重用于稳健地聚合异构的局部模型更新，提高了模型的泛化能力并降低了通信成本。
AI.motivation: 去中心化联邦学习（DFL）中，设备间的个体经验差异和交互程度不同，导致数据和模型初始化存在异构性。这种异构性造成局部模型参数的差异，从而减慢了收敛速度。
AI.method: 引入了一种新颖的聚合方法，通过显式处理局部模型中参数级别的不同证据可信度来解决异构性。具体来说，该方法通过近似局部模型在其本地数据集上的二阶信息来生成共识权重，并利用这些权重对邻域更新进行缩放，然后进行稳健聚合。
AI.result: 在计算机视觉任务的广泛实验中，所提出的方法展示了局部模型强大的泛化能力，同时降低了通信成本。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的DecHW方法通过利用二阶信息来生成共识权重，成功地解决了去中心化联邦学习中的数据和模型异构性问题，实现了强大的模型泛化能力和更低的通信成本。
AI.translation: 去中心化联邦学习（DFL）是一种无服务器的协作式机器学习范式，其中设备直接与邻近设备协作，交换模型信息以学习一个泛化模型。然而，个体经验的差异和设备交互程度的不同导致了设备间数据和模型初始化存在异构性。这种异构性使得局部模型参数存在差异，从而导致收敛速度变慢。本文通过明确处理局部模型中参数级别不同的证据可信度，来解决数据和模型异构性问题。本文引入了一种新颖的聚合方法，该方法捕获了局部模型中的这些参数变化，并对邻域局部更新执行稳健的聚合。具体而言，通过近似局部模型在其本地数据集上的二阶信息来生成共识权重。这些权重用于在将邻域更新聚合到全局邻域表示之前对其进行缩放。在计算机视觉任务的广泛实验中，所提出的方法展示了局部模型强大的泛化能力，同时降低了通信成本。
AI.summary: 针对去中心化联邦学习（DFL）中由数据和模型初始化异构性导致的收敛缓慢问题，本文提出了DecHW框架。DecHW引入了一种新颖的聚合策略，该策略通过近似局部模型的二阶信息来生成共识权重，从而稳健地聚合邻域更新。实验证明，该方法在降低通信成本的同时，显著提高了局部模型的泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 去中心化联邦学习, 异构性, 二阶信息, 共识权重, 稳健聚合
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于在去中心化联邦学习（DFL）的聚合过程中明确引入了二阶信息（通过近似 Hessian 或 Fisher 信息）来生成共识权重。这种方法超越了简单的平均或一阶加权，它允许模型根据参数在本地数据集上的“证据可信度”进行自适应加权，从而更稳健地处理异构性。这对于在实际、高异构性的边缘计算环境中稳定 DFL 模型的收敛和性能具有重要意义。

title: oculomix: Hierarchical Sampling for Retinal-Based Systemic Disease Prediction
summary: Oculomics - the concept of predicting systemic diseases, such as cardiovascular disease and dementia, through retinal imaging - has advanced rapidly due to the data efficiency of transformer-based foundation models like RETFound. Image-level mixed sample data augmentations, such as CutMix and MixUp, are frequently used for training transformers, yet these techniques perturb patient-specific attributes, such as medical comorbidity and clinical factors, since they only account for images and labels. To address this limitation, we propose a hierarchical sampling strategy, Oculomix, for mixed sample augmentations. Our method is based on two clinical priors. First (exam level), images acquired from the same patient at the same time point share the same attributes. Second (patient level), images acquired from the same patient at different time points have a soft temporal trend, as morbidity generally increases over time. Guided by these priors, our method constrains the mixing space to the patient and exam levels to better preserve patient-specific characteristics and leverages their hierarchical relationships. The proposed method is validated using ViT models on a five-year prediction of major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) in a large ethnically diverse population (Alzeye). We show that Oculomix consistently outperforms image-level CutMix and MixUp by up to 3% in AUROC, demonstrating the necessity and value of the proposed method in oculomics.

AI.title_translation: oculomix：用于基于视网膜的全身性疾病预测的分层采样
AI.tldr: 针对视网膜图像预测全身性疾病时，现有混合增强方法扰乱患者属性的问题，本文提出了Oculomix分层采样策略，通过限制混合空间到患者和检查级别，有效保留了患者特有特征，并在MACE预测任务中，AUROC性能比现有方法提高了3%。
AI.motivation: 现有的图像级混合样本数据增强（如CutMix和MixUp）只考虑图像和标签，在训练Transformer模型时会扰乱患者特有的属性（如医疗合并症和临床因素）。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为Oculomix的分层采样策略，用于混合样本增强。该方法基于两个临床先验（检查级别：同一时间点的图像共享相同属性；患者级别：不同时间点的图像具有软性时间趋势），将混合空间限制在患者和检查级别，以更好地保留患者特有的特征并利用它们的分层关系。该方法使用ViT模型进行验证。
AI.result: 在预测主要不良心血管事件（MACE）的五年预测任务中，Oculomix在AUROC方面一致优于图像级的CutMix和MixUp，性能提升高达3%。
AI.conclusion: Oculomix通过利用分层采样策略保留患者特有属性，证明了其在眼科组学中预测全身性疾病的必要性和价值。
AI.translation: 眼科组学——通过视网膜成像预测全身性疾病（如心血管疾病和痴呆症）的概念——由于像RETFound这样的基于Transformer的基座模型的数据效率而迅速发展。图像级混合样本数据增强（例如CutMix和MixUp）经常用于训练Transformer，但这些技术只考虑图像和标签，因此会扰乱患者特有的属性，例如医疗合并症和临床因素。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了一种用于混合样本增强的分层采样策略：Oculomix。我们的方法基于两个临床先验。首先（检查级别），在同一时间点从同一患者采集的图像共享相同的属性。其次（患者级别），在不同时间点从同一患者采集的图像具有软性时间趋势，因为发病率通常随时间增加。在这些先验的指导下，我们的方法将混合空间约束到患者和检查级别，以更好地保留患者特有的特征并利用它们的层次关系。所提出的方法使用ViT模型在一个大型多种族人群数据集（Alzeye）上进行了验证，用于主要不良心血管事件（MACE）的五年预测。我们表明，Oculomix在AUROC方面一致优于图像级CutMix和MixUp，性能提升高达3%，证明了该方法在眼科组学中的必要性和价值。
AI.summary: 眼科组学利用视网膜成像预测全身性疾病，但现有的图像级混合样本增强（如CutMix/MixUp）会干扰患者特有属性。为解决此问题，本文提出了Oculomix分层采样策略。该方法基于检查级别和患者级别的临床先验，将混合样本空间限制在这些层次上，以更好地保留患者特征并利用其分层关系。实验结果显示，在预测主要不良心血管事件（MACE）的任务中，Oculomix在AUROC上持续优于CutMix和MixUp，性能提升高达3%。
AI.keywords: Oculomix, 分层采样, 视网膜成像, 全身性疾病预测, 数据增强
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将临床先验知识融入到数据增强策略中，解决了现有图像级混合增强方法（如CutMix和MixUp）在处理具有多时间点和多检查属性的医疗数据时，可能破坏患者特有属性的关键限制。通过引入“患者级别”和“检查级别”的分层采样，Oculomix有效地利用了医疗数据的内在结构，提升了模型在眼科组学中预测全身性疾病的准确性。这对于推动医疗AI模型从单纯的图像处理转向更精细、更符合临床逻辑的数据处理具有重要意义。

title: Continuous-Flow Data-Rate-Aware CNN Inference on FPGA
summary: Among hardware accelerators for deep-learning inference, data flow implementations offer low latency and high throughput capabilities. In these architectures, each neuron is mapped to a dedicated hardware unit, making them well-suited for field-programmable gate array (FPGA) implementation. Previous unrolled implementations mostly focus on fully connected networks because of their simplicity, although it is well known that convolutional neural networks (CNNs) require fewer computations for the same accuracy. When observing the data flow in CNNs, pooling layers and convolutional layers with a stride larger than one, the number of data at their output is reduced with respect to their input. This data reduction strongly affects the data rate in a fully parallel implementation, making hardware units heavily underutilized unless it is handled properly. This work addresses this issue by analyzing the data flow of CNNs and presents a novel approach to designing data-rate-aware, continuous-flow CNN architectures. The proposed approach ensures a high hardware utilization close to 100% by interleaving low data rate signals and sharing hardware units, as well as using the right parallelization to achieve the throughput of a fully parallel implementation. The results show that a significant amount of the arithmetic logic can be saved, which allows implementing complex CNNs like MobileNet on a single FPGA with high throughput.

AI.title_translation: 连续流、数据速率感知型CNN在FPGA上的推理
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的方法，用于设计数据速率感知型的连续流CNN架构，通过交错低数据速率信号和共享硬件单元，解决了CNN中数据速率下降导致的硬件利用率低的问题，实现了接近100%的硬件利用率，并允许在单个FPGA上实现MobileNet等复杂网络。
AI.motivation: 深度学习推理的硬件加速器中，数据流实现具有低延迟和高吞吐量。然而，在CNN中，池化层和步幅大于一的卷积层会降低数据速率，导致硬件单元（在完全并行实现中）严重利用不足。本文旨在解决这一问题。
AI.method: 通过分析CNN的数据流，提出了一种新颖的数据速率感知型连续流CNN架构设计方法。该方法通过交错低数据速率信号、共享硬件单元以及使用恰当的并行化，确保了接近100%的高硬件利用率，并同时实现了完全并行实现的吞吐量。
