AI.title_translation: 渐进分辨率策略蒸馏：利用粗分辨率模拟实现时间高效的细分辨率策略学习
AI.tldr: 针对自主挖掘RL训练效率低的问题，研究者提出了PRPD框架。该框架通过逐步将策略从快速的粗分辨率模拟转移到高保真的细分辨率模拟，成功地将训练采样时间缩短至七分之一以下，同时保持了任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 在土方和建筑工程中实现自主挖掘，需要使用强化学习（RL）进行策略训练。然而，精确的细分辨率模拟计算耗时且样本收集困难，而快速的粗分辨率模拟与真实世界行为偏差大。动机在于结合两者的优点，在保持准确性的同时提高训练效率。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为渐进分辨率策略蒸馏（Progressive-Resolution Policy Distillation, PRPD）的新型策略学习框架。该方法通过一些中间分辨率模拟逐步转移策略，并采用保守的策略转移来避免领域差距导致的策略转移失败。
AI.result: PRPD将采样时间减少到不到1/7，同时保持了与在细分辨率模拟中学习策略所达到的相当的任务成功率。该结果在岩石挖掘模拟器和九个真实世界岩石环境中得到了验证。
AI.conclusion: PRPD成功地利用粗分辨率模拟显著加速了用于自主挖掘的细分辨率策略学习过程，同时保持了高性能。
AI.translation: 在土方工程和建筑中，挖掘机经常遇到混合有各种土壤条件的大块岩石，这需要熟练的操作员。本文提出了一个框架，利用强化学习（RL）通过岩石挖掘模拟器实现自主挖掘。在模拟中，分辨率可以通过整个土壤空间中的颗粒大小/数量来定义。细分辨率模拟能更接近地模仿真实世界的行为，但需要大量的计算时间和具有挑战性的样本收集，而粗分辨率模拟可以实现更快的样本收集，但会偏离真实世界的行为。为了结合这两种分辨率的优势，我们探索使用在粗分辨率模拟中开发的策略进行细分辨率模拟的预训练。为此，我们提出了一种新颖的策略学习框架，称为渐进分辨率策略蒸馏（Progressive-Resolution Policy Distillation, PRPD），它通过一些中间分辨率模拟逐步转移策略，并采用保守的策略转移以避免可能导致策略转移失败的领域差距。在岩石挖掘模拟器和九个真实世界岩石环境中的验证表明，PRPD将采样时间减少到不到1/7，同时保持了与在细分辨率模拟中学习策略所达到的相当的任务成功率。附加视频和补充结果可在我们的项目页面上获取：https://yuki-kadokawa.github.io/prpd/
AI.summary: 本文提出渐进分辨率策略蒸馏（PRPD）框架，旨在解决自主挖掘中强化学习策略训练的效率问题。PRPD通过利用快速的粗分辨率模拟进行预训练，并逐步通过中间分辨率和保守策略转移，最终高效地学习到细分辨率（接近真实世界）的策略。实验证明，PRPD在保持与细分辨率学习相当的成功率的同时，将采样时间缩短至1/7以下。
AI.keywords: 渐进分辨率策略蒸馏, 自主挖掘, 强化学习, 模拟分辨率, 策略迁移
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于提出了PRPD框架，巧妙地解决了强化学习在复杂物理模拟中面临的计算成本和精度之间的矛盾。通过将策略学习过程分解为渐进式的分辨率转移，并引入保守转移机制来桥接模拟域差距（domain gaps），它实现了在保证性能的前提下，显著提高训练效率（采样时间减少到1/7）。这对于需要高保真模拟但又对训练速度有要求的机器人或工程应用具有重要意义。

title: Hierarchical Multi-Agent DRL Based Dynamic Cluster Reconfiguration for UAV Mobility Management
summary: Multi-connectivity involves dynamic cluster formation among distributed access points (APs) and coordinated resource allocation from these APs, highlighting the need for efficient mobility management strategies for users with multi-connectivity. In this paper, we propose a novel mobility management scheme for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) that uses dynamic cluster reconfiguration with energy-efficient power allocation in a wireless interference network. Our objective encompasses meeting stringent reliability demands, minimizing joint power consumption, and reducing the frequency of cluster reconfiguration. To achieve these objectives, we propose a hierarchical multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (H-MADRL) framework, specifically tailored for dynamic clustering and power allocation. The edge cloud connected with a set of APs through low latency optical back-haul links hosts the high-level agent responsible for the optimal clustering policy, while low-level agents reside in the APs and are responsible for the power allocation policy. To further improve the learning efficiency, we propose a novel action-observation transition-driven learning algorithm that allows the low-level agents to use the action space from the high-level agent as part of the local observation space. This allows the lower-level agents to share partial information about the clustering policy and allocate the power more efficiently. The simulation results demonstrate that our proposed distributed algorithm achieves comparable performance to the centralized algorithm. Additionally, it offers better scalability, as the decision time for clustering and power allocation increases by only 10% when doubling the number of APs, compared to a 90% increase observed with the centralized approach.

AI.title_translation: 基于分层多智能体DRL的无人机移动性管理动态集群重配置
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于分层多智能体深度强化学习（H-MADRL）的无人机移动性管理方案，通过动态集群重配置和节能功率分配，最小化功耗和集群重配置频率。该分布式算法在性能上与集中式算法相当，但在扩展性上表现优越，当接入点（AP）数量加倍时，决策时间增长仅为10%。
AI.motivation: 针对具有多连接性的用户（特别是无人机，UAV），需要高效的移动性管理策略，涉及动态集群形成和协调资源分配。目标是设计一种方案，在无线干扰网络中，通过动态集群重配置和节能功率分配，满足严格的可靠性要求，最小化总功耗，并减少集群重配置的频率。
AI.method: 提出了一种分层多智能体深度强化学习（H-MADRL）框架，专门用于动态集群和功率分配。高层智能体（位于边缘云）负责最优集群策略；低层智能体（位于接入点AP）负责功率分配策略。为提高学习效率，提出了一种新颖的动作-观察转换驱动学习算法，允许低层智能体使用高层智能体的动作空间作为其本地观察空间的一部分，从而共享集群策略的部分信息，更有效地分配功率。
AI.result: 所提出的分布式算法实现了与集中式算法相当的性能。此外，它提供了更好的可扩展性：当AP数量加倍时，集群和功率分配的决策时间仅增加10%，而集中式方法观察到的增加为90%。
AI.translation: 多连接性涉及分布式接入点（AP）之间的动态集群形成以及来自这些AP的协调资源分配，这凸显了对具有多连接性的用户进行高效移动性管理策略的需求。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的无人机（UAV）移动性管理方案，该方案在无线干扰网络中使用动态集群重配置和节能功率分配。我们的目标包括满足严格的可靠性需求、最小化联合功耗以及减少集群重配置的频率。为实现这些目标，我们提出了一种分层多智能体深度强化学习（H-MADRL）框架，专门用于动态集群和功率分配。通过低延迟光纤回程链路连接到一组AP的边缘云托管着负责最优集群策略的高层智能体，而低层智能体驻留在AP中并负责功率分配策略。为了进一步提高学习效率，我们提出了一种新颖的动作-观察转换驱动学习算法，该算法允许低层智能体使用高层智能体的动作空间作为其本地观察空间的一部分。这使得低层智能体能够共享有关集群策略的部分信息，从而更有效地分配功率。仿真结果表明，我们提出的分布式算法实现了与集中式算法相当的性能。此外，它提供了更好的可扩展性，因为当AP数量加倍时，集群和功率分配的决策时间仅增加10%，而集中式方法观察到的增加为90%。
AI.summary: 本文针对无人机（UAV）多连接移动性管理问题，提出了一种基于分层多智能体深度强化学习（H-MADRL）的动态集群重配置和节能功率分配方案。该方案旨在满足可靠性要求、最小化功耗并减少集群重配置频率。H-MADRL框架将高层智能体用于集群策略，低层智能体用于功率分配。为增强效率，引入了动作-观察转换驱动学习算法，使低层智能体能利用高层智能体的集群信息。仿真结果表明，该分布式算法性能与集中式算法相当，且在扩展性方面表现出显著优势（AP数量加倍时决策时间仅增加10%）。
AI.keywords: 分层多智能体深度强化学习, 无人机移动性管理, 动态集群重配置, 节能功率分配, 扩展性
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将分层多智能体深度强化学习（H-MADRL）框架应用于无人机移动性管理中的动态集群和资源分配问题。特别是，提出的“动作-观察转换驱动学习算法”是一种新颖的机制，它允许智能体之间进行高效的部分信息共享（通过高层智能体的动作空间作为低层智能体的观察空间），有效解决了分布式控制中信息不对称和协作效率的问题。结果证明了该分布式方案在保持高性能的同时，极大地提高了系统的可扩展性，解决了传统集中式算法在网络规模扩大时决策时间急剧增加的限制，这对于实际的无线网络部署具有重要意义。

title: Speeding up an unsteady flow simulation by adaptive BDDC and Krylov subspace recycling
summary: We deal with accelerating the solution of a sequence of large linear systems solved by preconditioned conjugate gradient method (PCG). The sequence originates from time-stepping within a simulation of an unsteady incompressible flow. We apply a pressure correction scheme and focus on the solution of the Poisson problem for the pressure corrector. Its scalable solution presents the main computational challenge in many applications. The right-hand side of the problem changes in each time step, while the system matrix is constant and symmetric positive definite. The acceleration techniques are studied on a representative problem of flow around a unit sphere. Our baseline approach is based on a parallel solution of each problem in the sequence by nonoverlapping domain decomposition method. The interface problem is solved by PCG with the three-level BDDC preconditioner. As a preliminary step, an appropriate stopping criterion for the PCG iterations is chosen. Next, two techniques for accelerating the solution are gradually added to the baseline approach. Deflation is used within PCG with several approaches to Krylov subspace recycling. Finally, we add the adaptive selection of the coarse space within the three-level BDDC method. The paper is rich in experiments with careful measurements of computational times on a parallel supercomputer. The combination of the acceleration techniques eventually leads to saving more than 40 % of the computational time.

AI.title_translation: 通过自适应BDDC和Krylov子空间回收加速非定常流模拟
AI.tldr: 结合自适应BDDC和Krylov子空间回收技术，显著加速了非定常流模拟中的线性系统求解，节省了超过40%的计算时间。
AI.motivation: 加速非定常不可压缩流模拟中时间步进产生的、通过预处理共轭梯度法（PCG）求解的一系列大型线性系统的求解。其中，压力校正器泊松问题的可扩展求解是主要的计算挑战。
AI.method: 基础方法是基于非重叠域分解的并行求解，使用带有三级BDDC预条件子的PCG法。加速方法逐步添加：首先在PCG中引入Krylov子空间回收（通过紧缩/Deflation），然后增加三级BDDC方法中粗糙空间的自适应选择。
AI.result: 加速技术的组合最终节省了超过40%的计算时间。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合Krylov子空间回收和BDDC预条件子中粗糙空间的自适应选择，可以显著（超过40%）加速非定常流模拟中线性系统的求解。
AI.translation: 我们致力于加速通过预处理共轭梯度法（PCG）求解的一系列大型线性系统的解决方案。该序列来源于非定常不可压缩流模拟中的时间步进。我们应用压力校正方案，并专注于求解压力校正器的泊松问题。其可扩展的解决方案在许多应用中构成了主要的计算挑战。该问题的右侧项在每个时间步中都会变化，而系统矩阵是常数且对称正定的。我们在围绕单位球的流动这一代表性问题上研究了加速技术。我们的基线方法是基于非重叠域分解法对序列中的每个问题进行并行求解。界面问题通过带有三级BDDC预条件子的PCG求解。作为初步步骤，我们选择了PCG迭代的适当停止准则。接下来，我们逐步向基线方法添加了两种加速求解的技术。在PCG内部使用紧缩（Deflation），并结合了几种Krylov子空间回收方法。最后，我们添加了三级BDDC方法中粗糙空间的自适应选择。本文通过在并行超级计算机上仔细测量计算时间，进行了丰富的实验。加速技术的结合最终节省了超过40%的计算时间。
AI.summary: 本文旨在加速非定常不可压缩流模拟中时间步进产生的压力校正泊松问题的求解。作者以采用三级BDDC预条件子的PCG并行求解作为基线，并逐步引入两种加速技术：Krylov子空间回收（通过紧缩）和三级BDDC方法中粗糙空间的自适应选择。在并行超级计算机上的实验证明，这两种加速技术的结合能够节省超过40%的总计算时间。
AI.keywords: BDDC, Krylov子空间回收, 非定常流, PCG, 域分解
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将两种高效的线性系统加速技术——Krylov子空间回收和自适应域分解（BDDC）预条件子——进行了协同组合，并将其应用于非定常流模拟中的时间序列问题。由于系统矩阵在时间步进中保持不变，Krylov子空间的回收能够有效利用先前时间步的信息，显著提高计算效率。超过40%的计算时间节省证明了该方法在实际应用中的重要性和有效性。

title: Are LLMs Really Not Knowledgeable? Mining the Submerged Knowledge in LLMs' Memory
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise as parametric knowledge bases, but often underperform on question answering (QA) tasks due to hallucinations and uncertainty. While prior work attributes these failures to knowledge gaps in the model's parameters, we uncover a complementary phenomenon: LLMs frequently retain correct knowledge even when generating incorrect or "unsure" answers. By analyzing the token-level output distributions, we find that correct answers often appear among high-probability candidates, despite not being selected. Motivated by this, we propose Hits@k, a novel metric to evaluate latent knowledge retention independent of answer surface form. Our experiments reveal that LLMs possess significantly more factual knowledge than is reflected by standard QA accuracy. Building on these insights, we further examine the prevailing few-shot QA paradigm. We find that prompting strategies which allow "unsure" outputs can inadvertently suppress correct answers by discouraging low-confidence generation. We design a set of quantitative experiments to measure this suppression effect, offering practical guidance for future prompt and decoding design in knowledge-intensive tasks.

AI.title_translation: LLM真的缺乏知识吗？挖掘其记忆中潜藏的知识。
AI.tldr: LLM经常知道答案但未选中。我们提出了Hits@k指标来衡量这种潜在知识，并发现允许“不确定”输出的提示策略会抑制正确的低置信度答案，从而压制了模型本应知道的知识。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM在问答任务中表现不佳，经常产生幻觉或不确定性，但本文旨在探索LLM是否在生成错误或“不确定”答案时仍保留了正确知识，从而挑战知识差距是失败唯一原因的传统观点。
AI.method: 分析token级别的输出分布，发现正确答案出现在高概率候选者中。提出了一个新的评估潜在知识保留的指标`Hits@k`。设计了一套定量的实验来衡量提示策略对正确答案的抑制效应。
AI.result: LLM拥有的事实知识显著多于标准问答准确率所反映的水平。允许“不确定”输出的提示策略可能会通过抑制低置信度生成而无意中压制正确答案。
AI.conclusion: 本研究发现LLM保留了大量的潜在知识，并揭示了现有提示策略对知识输出的抑制作用，为知识密集型任务中未来的提示和解码设计提供了实用指导。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）已显示出作为参数化知识库的潜力，但由于幻觉和不确定性，它们在问答（QA）任务中表现往往不佳。虽然先前的研究将这些失败归因于模型参数中的知识差距，但我们发现了一个互补的现象：即使在生成不正确或“不确定”的答案时，LLM也经常保留正确的知识。通过分析token级别的输出分布，我们发现正确答案通常出现在高概率候选者中，尽管它们未被选中。受此启发，我们提出了Hits@k，这是一个独立于答案表面形式来评估潜在知识保留的新指标。我们的实验表明，LLM拥有的事实知识显著多于标准QA准确率所反映的水平。基于这些见解，我们进一步检验了流行的少样本QA范式。我们发现，允许“不确定”输出的提示策略可能会通过抑制低置信度生成而无意中压制正确答案。我们设计了一套定量的实验来衡量这种抑制效应，为未来知识密集型任务中的提示和解码设计提供了实用指导。
AI.summary: LLM即使给出错误或不确定的答案，也经常保留着正确的知识。本文通过分析token级分布，提出了`Hits@k`指标来衡量这种潜在知识，并证实LLM的知识储备远超标准准确率。研究还揭示了允许“不确定”答案的常见少样本提示策略可能会抑制正确的低置信度生成，并为未来的提示和解码设计提供了指导。
AI.keywords: 潜在知识, 大型语言模型, 问答, Hits@k, 提示策略
AI.comments: 这篇论文极具创新性，因为它挑战了LLM失败完全归因于知识差距的基本假设。通过关注潜在知识（模型本可以输出的内容），它将研究重点从参数训练转移到输出解码和提示策略上。本文提出的`Hits@k`指标为评估LLM的真实知识储备提供了一个更精细的视角，并揭示了现有提示策略（如允许“不确定”输出）可能无意中成为性能瓶颈，为在不重新训练的情况下提高LLM在知识密集型任务上的表现提供了可操作的见解。

title: Structural and Statistical Audio Texture Knowledge Distillation for Environmental Sound Classification
summary: While knowledge distillation has shown success in various audio tasks, its application to environmental sound classification often overlooks essential low-level audio texture features needed to capture local patterns in complex acoustic environments. To address this gap, the Structural and Statistical Audio Texture Knowledge Distillation (SSATKD) framework is proposed, which combines high-level contextual information with low-level structural and statistical audio textures extracted from intermediate layers. To evaluate its generalizability to a broad range of applications, SSATKD is tested on four diverse datasets within the environmental sound classification domain, namely two passive sonar datasets: DeepShip and Vessel Type Underwater Acoustic Data (VTUAD) and two general environmental sound datasets: Environmental Sound Classification 50 (ESC-50) and UrbanSound8K. Two teacher adaptation strategies are explored: classifier-head-only adaptation and full fine-tuning. The framework is further evaluated using various convolutional and transformer-based teacher models. Experimental results demonstrate consistent accuracy improvements across all datasets and settings, confirming the effectiveness and robustness of SSATKD in real-world sound classification tasks.

AI.title_translation: 结构化和统计化音频纹理知识蒸馏用于环境声分类
AI.tldr: 针对环境声分类中的知识蒸馏忽略低级音频纹理特征的问题，本文提出了结构化和统计化音频纹理知识蒸馏（SSATKD）框架，通过结合高层上下文信息和中层提取的低层纹理特征，在四个不同数据集上显著提高了分类准确率和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的知识蒸馏方法在应用于环境声分类时，通常忽略了捕获复杂声学环境中局部模式所必需的基本低级音频纹理特征。
AI.method: 提出了结构化和统计化音频纹理知识蒸馏（SSATKD）框架。该方法结合了高层上下文信息以及从中层提取的低层结构化和统计化音频纹理特征。通过探索两种教师模型适应策略（仅分类头适应和完全微调），并在多种基于卷积和基于Transformer的教师模型上进行了评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，SSATKD在所有数据集和设置中均表现出持续的准确性提升。
AI.conclusion: SSATKD框架在实际环境声分类任务中具有有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 尽管知识蒸馏在各种音频任务中取得了成功，但其在环境声分类中的应用往往忽略了捕获复杂声学环境中局部模式所必需的基本低级音频纹理特征。为了弥补这一空白，本文提出了结构化和统计化音频纹理知识蒸馏（SSATKD）框架，该框架将高层上下文信息与从中层提取的低层结构化和统计化音频纹理相结合。为了评估其对广泛应用的泛化能力，SSATKD在环境声分类领域的四个不同数据集上进行了测试，包括两个被动声纳数据集：DeepShip和船舶类型水下声学数据（VTUAD），以及两个通用环境声数据集：环境声分类50（ESC-50）和UrbanSound8K。研究探索了两种教师模型适应策略：仅分类头适应和完全微调。该框架还使用各种基于卷积和基于Transformer的教师模型进行了进一步评估。实验结果表明，在所有数据集和设置中，准确性均得到持续改善，证实了SSATKD在实际声分类任务中的有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新的知识蒸馏框架——结构化和统计化音频纹理知识蒸馏（SSATKD），旨在解决传统知识蒸馏在环境声分类中忽略低级音频纹理特征的问题。SSATKD通过整合高层上下文信息和从中层提取的低层结构化与统计化音频纹理特征来增强模型性能。该框架在 DeepShip、VTUAD、ESC-50 和 UrbanSound8K 四个多样化数据集上，结合两种教师模型适应策略和多种教师模型结构进行了广泛测试。实验结果一致证明，SSATKD在不同设置和数据集上均能持续提高分类准确率，展现出在实际应用中的有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 知识蒸馏, 环境声分类, 音频纹理特征, SSATKD, 结构化和统计化知识
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于明确指出并解决了知识蒸馏在环境声分类中对低级音频纹理特征的忽视问题。通过引入结构化和统计化的音频纹理知识，SSATKD有效地将局部模式信息融入蒸馏过程，从而提高了模型在复杂声学环境中的泛化能力和鲁棒性。该方法在四种不同类型的环境声数据集（包括水下声纳和通用环境声）上进行了验证，证明了其广泛的适用性。

title: FLOL: Fast Baselines for Real-World Low-Light Enhancement
summary: Low-Light Image Enhancement (LLIE) is a key task in computational photography and imaging. The problem of enhancing images captured during night or in dark environments has been well-studied in the computer vision literature. However, current deep learning-based solutions struggle with efficiency and robustness for real-world scenarios (e.g., scenes with noise, saturated pixels). We propose a lightweight neural network that combines image processing in the frequency and spatial domains. Our baseline method, FLOL, is one of the fastest models for this task, achieving results comparable to the state-of-the-art on popular real-world benchmarks such as LOLv2, LSRW, MIT-5K and UHD-LL. Moreover, we are able to process 1080p images in real-time under 12ms. Code and models at https://github.com/cidautai/FLOL

AI.title_translation: FLOL：真实世界低光增强的快速基线
AI.tldr: 提出FLOL，一个结合频域和空域处理的轻量级神经网络，用于快速、鲁棒地增强真实世界低光图像，达到SOTA性能并实现实时处理。
AI.motivation: 当前基于深度学习的低光图像增强方法在真实世界场景（如存在噪声、饱和像素的场景）中存在效率和鲁棒性问题。
AI.method: 提出一个轻量级神经网络，结合频域和空域的图像处理。
AI.result: FLOL是该任务中最快的模型之一，在LOLv2、LSRW、MIT-5K和UHD-LL等真实世界基准测试上取得了与最先进技术相当的结果，并且能够以低于12毫秒的速度实时处理1080p图像。
AI.conclusion: FLOL提供了一个高效且鲁棒的解决方案，用于真实世界低光图像增强，其速度和性能均达到或超越现有先进水平。
AI.translation: 低光图像增强（LLIE）是计算摄影和成像中的一项关键任务。在计算机视觉文献中，对夜间或黑暗环境中捕获图像的增强问题已进行了深入研究。然而，当前基于深度学习的解决方案在真实世界场景（例如，有噪声、饱和像素的场景）中在效率和鲁棒性方面存在困难。我们提出了一个轻量级神经网络，它结合了频域和空域的图像处理。我们的基线方法FLOL是该任务中最快的模型之一，在LOLv2、LSRW、MIT-5K和UHD-LL等流行的真实世界基准测试上取得了与最先进技术相当的结果。此外，我们能够以低于12毫秒的速度实时处理1080p图像。代码和模型可在https://github.com/cidautai/FLOL获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为FLOL的轻量级神经网络，旨在解决当前深度学习低光图像增强方法在真实世界场景中效率和鲁棒性不足的问题。FLOL结合了频域和空域的图像处理，被证明是该任务中最快的模型之一，并在多个主流真实世界基准测试上取得了与最先进技术相当的性能，同时实现了1080p图像的实时处理。
AI.keywords: 低光图像增强, 实时处理, 轻量级神经网络, 频域处理, 空域处理
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个轻量级网络，通过结合频域和空域处理，在保证速度的同时达到了与SOTA相当的性能，并解决了真实世界场景中的效率和鲁棒性问题。实时处理1080p图像的能力是其显著优势，使其在实际应用中具有很高的价值。

title: Dense-SfM: Structure from Motion with Dense Consistent Matching
summary: We present Dense-SfM, a novel Structure from Motion (SfM) framework designed for dense and accurate 3D reconstruction from multi-view images. Sparse keypoint matching, which traditional SfM methods often rely on, limits both accuracy and point density, especially in texture-less areas. Dense-SfM addresses this limitation by integrating dense matching with a Gaussian Splatting (GS) based track extension which gives more consistent, longer feature tracks. To further improve reconstruction accuracy, Dense-SfM is equipped with a multi-view kernelized matching module leveraging transformer and Gaussian Process architectures, for robust track refinement across multi-views. Evaluations on the ETH3D and Texture-Poor SfM datasets show that Dense-SfM offers significant improvements in accuracy and density over state-of-the-art methods. Project page: https://icetea-cv.github.io/densesfm/.

AI.title_translation: Dense-SfM: 基于密集一致匹配的运动结构
AI.tldr: Dense-SfM是一个新颖的运动结构（SfM）框架，通过整合密集匹配和基于高斯泼溅的轨迹扩展，实现了从多视角图像中进行密集且准确的3D重建，并在准确性和密度上超越了现有最先进的方法。
AI.motivation: 传统SfM方法常依赖稀疏关键点匹配，这限制了3D重建的准确性和点密度，尤其是在无纹理区域。
AI.method: Dense-SfM通过将密集匹配与基于高斯泼溅（GS）的轨迹扩展相结合，以生成更一致、更长的特征轨迹。为了进一步提高重建精度，它还配备了一个多视角核化匹配模块，该模块利用Transformer和高斯过程架构进行鲁棒的跨多视角轨迹细化。
AI.result: 在ETH3D和Texture-Poor SfM数据集上的评估表明，Dense-SfM在准确性和密度方面比现有最先进的方法有显著改进。
AI.conclusion: Dense-SfM通过其创新的密集匹配和轨迹细化方法，成功克服了传统SfM在稀疏匹配上的局限性，实现了更准确和更密集的3D重建，达到了最先进的性能。
AI.translation: 我们提出了Dense-SfM，这是一个新颖的运动结构（SfM）框架，旨在从多视角图像中进行密集且准确的3D重建。传统的SfM方法常依赖的稀疏关键点匹配，限制了准确性和点密度，尤其是在无纹理区域。Dense-SfM通过将密集匹配与基于高斯泼溅（GS）的轨迹扩展相结合来解决这一限制，从而产生更一致、更长的特征轨迹。为了进一步提高重建精度，Dense-SfM配备了一个多视角核化匹配模块，该模块利用Transformer和高斯过程架构，用于跨多视角的鲁棒轨迹细化。在ETH3D和Texture-Poor SfM数据集上的评估表明，Dense-SfM在准确性和密度方面比现有方法有显著改进。项目页面：https://icetea-cv.github.io/densesfm/。
AI.summary: Dense-SfM是一个旨在解决传统SfM在稀疏关键点匹配限制的新型框架，它通过整合密集匹配与基于高斯泼溅的轨迹扩展来生成更长、更一致的特征轨迹。此外，它还利用了结合Transformer和高斯过程架构的多视角核化匹配模块进行轨迹细化，从而实现更密集和准确的3D重建。实验证明，Dense-SfM在准确性和密度上均优于现有最先进的方法。
AI.keywords: 运动结构, 密集匹配, 高斯泼溅, 3D重建, 多视角
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入密集匹配、高斯泼溅和Transformer/高斯过程的结合，有效地解决了传统SfM在无纹理区域和稀疏匹配上的核心挑战，显著提升了3D重建的准确性和密度，具有重要的创新性和实用价值。

title: Helping Johnny Make Sense of Privacy Policies with LLMs
summary: Understanding and engaging with privacy policies is crucial for online privacy, yet these documents remain notoriously complex and difficult to navigate. We present PRISMe, an interactive browser extension that combines LLM-based policy assessment with a dashboard and customizable chat interface, enabling users to skim quick overviews or explore policy details in depth while browsing. We conduct a user study (N=22) with participants of diverse privacy knowledge to investigate how users interpret the tool's explanations and how it shapes their engagement with privacy policies, identifying distinct interaction patterns. Participants valued the clear overviews and conversational depth, but flagged some issues, particularly adversarial robustness and hallucination risks. Thus, we investigate how a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approach can alleviate issues by re-running the chat queries from the study. Our findings surface design challenges as well as technical trade-offs, contributing actionable insights for developing future user-centered, trustworthy privacy policy analysis tools.

AI.title_translation: 利用大型语言模型帮助约翰尼理解隐私政策
AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了一个名为PRISMe的浏览器扩展，使用LLM帮助用户理解复杂的隐私政策，通过研究发现用户喜欢清晰的概述，但也存在幻觉风险，并探索了使用RAG来改进工具。
AI.motivation: 理解和参与隐私政策对于在线隐私至关重要，但这些文档仍然极其复杂且难以驾驭。
AI.method: 提出了一个名为PRISMe的交互式浏览器扩展，它结合了基于LLM的策略评估、仪表板和可定制的聊天界面。通过对22名具有不同隐私知识的用户进行研究，考察了他们对工具解释的理解和参与度，并随后研究了使用检索增强生成（RAG）方法来缓解聊天查询中的问题。
AI.result: 参与者重视清晰的概述和对话深度，但也指出了对抗性鲁棒性和幻觉风险等问题。RAG方法被研究用于缓解这些问题。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果揭示了设计挑战以及技术权衡，为开发未来以用户为中心、值得信赖的隐私政策分析工具提供了可操作的见解。
AI.translation: 理解和参与隐私政策对于在线隐私至关重要，但这些文档仍然是出了名地复杂且难以导航。我们提出了PRISMe，一个交互式浏览器扩展，它结合了基于LLM的策略评估与仪表板和可定制的聊天界面，使用户在浏览时能够快速浏览概述或深入探索策略细节。我们进行了一项用户研究（N=22），参与者具有不同的隐私知识，以调查用户如何解释工具的解释以及它如何影响他们对隐私政策的参与，确定了不同的交互模式。参与者重视清晰的概述和对话深度，但指出了某些问题，特别是对抗性鲁棒性和幻觉风险。因此，我们研究了检索增强生成（RAG）方法如何通过重新运行研究中的聊天查询来缓解问题。我们的发现浮现了设计挑战以及技术权衡，为开发未来以用户为中心、值得信赖的隐私政策分析工具做出了可操作的贡献。
AI.summary: PRISMe是一个创新的浏览器扩展，利用大型语言模型（LLM）来评估和简化隐私政策，通过仪表板和聊天界面使用户能够快速浏览或深入探索政策细节。用户研究表明了工具的价值，但也突显了对抗性鲁棒性和幻觉等挑战，促使研究人员探索使用检索增强生成（RAG）来提高工具的可信度。
AI.keywords: 隐私政策, 大语言模型, 交互式工具, 检索增强生成, 用户研究
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于结合了LLM评估、仪表板和可定制聊天界面，提供了一种交互式方式来简化隐私政策的理解。它对未来以用户为中心、值得信赖的隐私政策分析工具的设计挑战和技术权衡提供了可操作的见解。局限性包括用户研究中发现的对抗性鲁棒性和幻觉风险。

title: Enhancing Model Defense Against Jailbreaks with Proactive Safety Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are vital for a wide range of applications yet remain susceptible to jailbreak threats, which could lead to the generation of inappropriate responses. Conventional defenses, such as refusal and adversarial training, often fail to cover corner cases or rare domains, leaving LLMs still vulnerable to more sophisticated attacks. We propose a novel defense strategy, Safety Chain-of-Thought (SCoT), which harnesses the enhanced \textit{reasoning capabilities} of LLMs for proactive assessment of harmful inputs, rather than simply blocking them. SCoT augments any refusal training datasets to critically analyze the intent behind each request before generating answers. By employing proactive reasoning, SCoT enhances the generalization of LLMs across varied harmful queries and scenarios not covered in the safety alignment corpus. Additionally, it generates detailed refusals specifying the rules violated. Comparative evaluations show that SCoT significantly surpasses existing defenses, reducing vulnerability to out-of-distribution issues and adversarial manipulations while maintaining strong general capabilities.

AI.title_translation: 利用主动安全推理增强模型防御以抵御越狱攻击
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为SCoT的新防御策略，它利用大语言模型的推理能力来主动评估和拒绝越狱请求，而不是被动地进行训练或拦截，这种方法在处理未见过的情况时表现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）易受越狱威胁，可能生成不当回复；传统的防御方法（如拒绝和对抗性训练）往往无法覆盖边缘情况或罕见领域，使LLM仍然容易受到更复杂的攻击。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为安全思维链（Safety Chain-of-Thought, SCoT）的新颖防御策略，它利用LLM增强的推理能力，对有害输入进行主动评估，而不是简单地阻止。SCoT通过增强任何拒绝训练数据集来批判性地分析每个请求背后的意图，然后生成详细的、指明所违反规则的拒绝回复。
AI.result: 与现有防御方法相比，SCoT显著超越了它们，减少了对分布外问题和对抗性操纵的漏洞，同时保持了强大的通用能力。
AI.conclusion: SCoT通过主动推理显著超越了现有防御方法，减少了对分布外问题和对抗性操作的漏洞，同时保持了强大的通用能力。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）对广泛应用至关重要，但仍然容易受到越狱威胁，这可能导致生成不当的回复。传统的防御方法，如拒绝和对抗性训练，往往未能覆盖边缘情况或罕见领域，使LLMs仍然容易受到更复杂的攻击。我们提出了一种新颖的防御策略，安全思维链（Safety Chain-of-Thought, SCoT），它利用LLM增强的*推理能力*对有害输入进行主动评估，而不是简单地阻止它们。SCoT增强了任何拒绝训练数据集，以批判性地分析每个请求背后的意图，然后再生成答案。通过采用主动推理，SCoT增强了LLM在安全对齐语料库中未涵盖的各种有害查询和场景中的泛化能力。此外，它会生成详细的拒绝信息，指明所违反的规则。比较评估表明，SCoT显著超越了现有防御，减少了对分布外问题和对抗性操纵的漏洞，同时保持了强大的通用能力。
AI.summary: 为应对大型语言模型（LLMs）易受越狱攻击的问题，本文提出了一种名为安全思维链（SCoT）的新型防御策略。SCoT利用LLM的推理能力主动分析有害输入的意图，而非被动拦截，并通过生成详细的拒绝信息来增强泛化性。实验证明，SCoT在鲁棒性和通用性方面优于现有防御方法。
AI.keywords: 模型防御, 越狱攻击, 安全思维链, 主动推理, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 该方法SCoT的创新点在于将LLM的推理能力用于“主动评估”有害输入，而不是被动地进行拦截，这提高了对未覆盖场景的泛化能力。其重要性在于提供了一种更具鲁棒性的防御机制。局限性在于抽象中未提及具体的性能指标或计算开销。

title: CTC-DRO: Robust Optimization for Reducing Language Disparities in Speech Recognition
summary: Modern deep learning models often achieve high overall performance, but consistently fail on specific subgroups. Group distributionally robust optimization (group DRO) addresses this problem by minimizing the worst-group loss, but it fails when group losses misrepresent performance differences between groups. This is common in domains like speech, where the widely used connectionist temporal classification (CTC) loss not only scales with input length but also varies with linguistic and acoustic properties, leading to spurious differences between group losses. We present CTC-DRO, which addresses the shortcomings of the group DRO objective by smoothing the group weight update to prevent overemphasis on consistently high-loss groups, while using input length-matched batching to mitigate CTC's scaling issues. We evaluate CTC-DRO on the task of multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) across five language sets from the diverse ML-SUPERB 2.0 benchmark. CTC-DRO consistently outperforms group DRO and CTC-based baseline models, reducing the worst-language error by up to 47.1% and the average error by up to 32.9%. CTC-DRO can be applied to ASR with minimal computational costs, and, while motivated by multilingual ASR, offers the potential for reducing group disparities in other domains with similar challenges.

AI.title_translation: CTC-DRO：用于减少语音识别中语言差异的鲁棒优化
AI.tldr: 为了解决语音识别中CTC损失导致的Group DRO失效问题，我们提出了CTC-DRO，它通过平滑更新和长度匹配批处理来优化最差组损失，结果显示该方法显著降低了多语言ASR中的语言错误差异。
AI.motivation: 现代深度学习模型在特定子群上的表现不佳，Group DRO旨在通过最小化最差组损失来解决此问题，但在语音识别等领域，CTC损失会随输入长度和语言/声学特性变化，导致组损失的差异不能准确反映性能差异，Group DRO因此失效。
AI.method: 提出CTC-DRO方法，通过平滑组权重更新以防止过度强调持续高损失的组，并使用输入长度匹配的批处理来缓解CTC损失的缩放问题，从而解决Group DRO目标在CTC损失下的不足。
AI.result: CTC-DRO在ML-SUPERB 2.0基准测试的五组语言上进行评估，一致地优于Group DRO和基于CTC的基线模型，将最差语言错误率降低了高达47.1%，平均错误率降低了高达32.9%。
AI.conclusion: CTC-DRO在多语言自动语音识别任务中持续优于Group DRO和基于CTC的基线模型，将最差语言错误率降低了高达47.1%，平均错误率降低了高达32.9%。它以最小的计算成本应用于ASR，并有望减少其他具有类似挑战的领域的组间差异。
AI.translation: 现代深度学习模型通常能取得很高的总体性能，但却持续在特定子群上表现不佳。组分布鲁棒优化（group DRO）通过最小化最差组损失来解决这个问题，但当组损失不能准确代表组间的性能差异时，它就会失效。这在语音等领域很常见，其中广泛使用的连接主义时序分类（CTC）损失不仅随输入长度缩放，还随语言和声学特性变化，导致组损失之间出现虚假差异。我们提出了CTC-DRO，它通过平滑组权重更新以防止过度强调持续高损失的组，同时使用输入长度匹配的批处理来缓解CTC的缩放问题，从而解决了Group DRO目标在CTC损失下的缺点。我们在来自多样化ML-SUPERB 2.0基准的五组语言上对多语言自动语音识别（ASR）任务评估了CTC-DRO。CTC-DRO一致地优于Group DRO和基于CTC的基线模型，将最差语言错误率降低了高达47.1%，平均错误率降低了高达32.9%。CTC-DRO可以以最小的计算成本应用于ASR，并且虽然其动机是多语言ASR，但它有潜力减少其他具有类似挑战的领域的组间差异。
AI.summary: 本文提出了CTC-DRO，一种用于减少语音识别中语言差异的鲁棒优化方法。它通过平滑组权重更新和使用输入长度匹配的批处理来克服Group DRO在CTC损失下因损失缩放和变化导致的局限性。实验证明CTC-DRO能显著降低最差语言的错误率。
AI.keywords: CTC-DRO, 语音识别, 分布鲁棒优化, 语言差异, 多语言ASR
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地结合了分布鲁棒优化（DRO）和连接主义时序分类（CTC）的特点，提出了一种平滑权重更新和匹配输入长度批处理的方法来解决CTC损失在语音识别中带来的组间误差误导问题。其重要性在于显著降低了多语言ASR中的最差语言错误率，具有很强的实际应用价值。局限性在于其主要针对CTC损失，对其他损失函数的适用性未明确说明。

title: Mitigating Sensitive Information Leakage in LLMs4Code through Machine Unlearning
summary: Large Language Models for Code (LLMs4Code) have achieved strong performance in code generation, but recent studies reveal that they may memorize and leak sensitive information contained in training data, posing serious privacy risks. To address this gap, this work presents the first comprehensive empirical study on applying machine unlearning to mitigate sensitive information leakage in LLMs4Code. We first construct a dedicated benchmark that includes: (i) a synthetic forget set containing diverse forms of personal information, and (ii) a retain set designed to evaluate whether code-generation capability is preserved after unlearning. Using this benchmark, we systematically assess three representative unlearning algorithms (GA, GA+GD, GA+KL) across three widely used open-source LLMs4Code models (AIXCoder-7B, CodeLlama-7B, CodeQwen-7B). Experimental results demonstrate that machine unlearning can substantially reduce direct memorization-based leakage: on average, the direct leak rate drops by more than 50% while retaining about over 91% of the original code-generation performance. Moreover, by analyzing post-unlearning outputs, we uncover a consistent shift from direct to indirect leakage, revealing an underexplored vulnerability that persists even when the target data has been successfully forgotten. Our findings show that machine unlearning is a feasible and effective solution for enhancing privacy protection in LLMs4Code, while also highlighting the need for future techniques capable of mitigating both direct and indirect leakage simultaneously.

AI.title_translation: 通过机器遗忘减轻代码大语言模型中的敏感信息泄露
AI.tldr: 研究人员发现用机器遗忘技术可以大幅减少代码生成模型（LLMs4Code）直接泄露敏感信息，性能损失很小。但遗忘后，模型会转向以更隐蔽的间接方式泄露数据，表明需要更全面的隐私保护方法。
AI.motivation: LLMs4Code在代码生成方面表现出色，但可能记忆并泄露训练数据中包含的敏感信息，带来严重隐私风险。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含合成遗忘集和保留集的专用基准，并系统评估了三种代表性的遗忘算法（GA, GA+GD, GA+KL）在三种主流LLMs4Code模型上的性能。
AI.result: 机器遗忘能显著减少基于直接记忆的泄露，平均直接泄露率下降超过50%，同时保留了超过91%的原始代码生成性能。分析发现，在遗忘目标数据后，泄露模式会从直接泄露一致地转向间接泄露。
AI.conclusion: 机器遗忘是增强LLMs4Code隐私保护的可行且有效的方法，但未来的技术需要能够同时减轻直接和间接泄露。
AI.translation: 代码大语言模型（LLMs4Code）在代码生成方面取得了强大的性能，但最近的研究显示它们可能会记忆并泄露训练数据中包含的敏感信息，带来了严重的隐私风险。为解决这一差距，本工作首次提出了关于将机器遗忘应用于减轻LLMs4Code中敏感信息泄露的全面实证研究。我们首先构建了一个专用基准，其中包括：（i）包含各种形式个人信息的合成遗忘集，以及（ii）旨在评估遗忘后代码生成能力是否保持的保留集。使用此基准，我们系统地评估了三种代表性的遗忘算法（GA, GA+GD, GA+KL）在三种广泛使用的开源LLMs4Code模型（AIXCoder-7B, CodeLlama-7B, CodeQwen-7B）上的表现。实验结果表明，机器遗忘可以显著减少基于直接记忆的泄露：平均而言，直接泄露率下降了50%以上，同时保留了原始代码生成性能的91%以上。此外，通过分析遗忘后的输出，我们发现了一个持续存在的、未被充分探索的漏洞——泄露从直接转向间接，即使目标数据已被成功遗忘。我们的研究结果表明，机器遗忘是增强LLMs4Code隐私保护的可行且有效的方法，同时也凸显了未来需要能够同时减轻直接和间接泄露的技术。
AI.summary: 本研究首次全面实证研究了将机器遗忘应用于代码大语言模型（LLMs4Code）以减轻敏感信息泄露。通过构建专用基准并评估现有遗忘算法，研究表明遗忘技术能有效降低直接泄露率（平均下降超50%），同时保持大部分代码生成能力（超91%）。然而，研究还发现泄露会转移到间接形式，提示需要开发能同时解决直接和间接泄露的新技术。
AI.keywords: 机器遗忘, 代码大语言模型, 敏感信息泄露, 隐私保护, 直接/间接泄露
AI.comments: 这项工作首次系统地将机器遗忘技术应用于代码大语言模型（LLMs4Code）以减轻敏感信息泄露，并构建了专门的基准数据集。其创新点在于不仅评估了遗忘的有效性，还揭示了从直接泄露到间接泄露的“转移”现象，指出了现有方法的局限性。尽管取得了显著的直接泄露缓解效果，但间接泄露的持续存在是未来研究的重点。

title: Universal Sequence Preconditioning
summary: We study the problem of preconditioning in sequential prediction. From the theoretical lens of linear dynamical systems, we show that convolving the target sequence corresponds to applying a polynomial to the hidden transition matrix. Building on this insight, we propose a universal preconditioning method that convolves the target with coefficients from orthogonal polynomials such as Chebyshev or Legendre. We prove that this approach reduces regret for two distinct prediction algorithms and yields the first ever sublinear and hidden-dimension-independent regret bounds (up to logarithmic factors) that hold for systems with marginally table and asymmetric transition matrices. Finally, extensive synthetic and real-world experiments show that this simple preconditioning strategy improves the performance of a diverse range of algorithms, including recurrent neural networks, and generalizes to signals beyond linear dynamical systems.

AI.tldr: 研究了序列预测中的预处理问题，发现通过用正交多项式系数卷积目标序列可以作为一种通用预处理方法，该方法在理论上为某些复杂系统（如边缘稳定、非对称转移矩阵）实现了更优的遗憾界（次线性且不依赖于隐藏维度），并在实践中提升了RNN等算法的性能。
AI.motivation: 研究序列预测中的预处理问题。
AI.method: 通过研究线性动力系统的理论，证明目标序列的卷积等同于对隐藏转移矩阵应用一个多项式。基于此，提出了一种通用预处理方法，将目标序列与来自正交多项式（如Chebyshev或Legendre）的系数进行卷积。
AI.result: 证明了所提出的预处理方法可以减少两种不同预测算法的遗憾（regret），并实现了首次针对具有边缘稳定和非对称转移矩阵的系统所能达到的次线性且独立于隐藏维度的遗憾界（直到对数因子）。
AI.conclusion: 这种简单的预处理策略提高了包括循环神经网络在内的一系列算法的性能，并可推广到线性动力系统以外的信号。
AI.translation: 我们研究了序列预测中的预处理问题。从线性动力系统的理论角度来看，我们证明了对目标序列进行卷积等同于将一个多项式应用于隐藏转移矩阵。基于这一洞察，我们提出了一种通用的预处理方法，即将目标序列与来自正交多项式（如Chebyshev或Legendre）的系数进行卷积。我们证明了这种方法可以减少两种不同预测算法的遗憾，并实现了首次针对具有边缘稳定和非对称转移矩阵的系统所能达到的次线性且独立于隐藏维度的遗憾界（直到对数因子）。最后，广泛的合成和真实世界实验表明，这种简单的预处理策略提高了包括循环神经网络在内的一系列算法的性能，并可推广到线性动力系统以外的信号。
AI.summary: 本文研究了序列预测中的预处理问题，从线性动力系统的角度出发，提出了一种通用预处理方法，即用正交多项式的系数对目标序列进行卷积。该方法被证明可以减小两种预测算法的遗憾，并首次实现了对具有边缘稳定和非对称转移矩阵的系统而言，次线性且独立于隐藏维度的遗憾界。实验表明该策略能提升多种算法的性能。
AI.keywords: 序列预测, 预处理, 遗憾界, 线性动力系统, 正交多项式
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于从线性动力系统的理论角度出发，将序列预处理与目标序列的卷积联系起来，并提出了基于正交多项式系数的通用预处理方法。其重要性在于首次为具有边缘稳定和非对称转移矩阵的系统实现了次线性且独立于隐藏维度的遗憾界。局限性方面，摘要中未明确指出。

title: DiffRatio: Training One-Step Diffusion Models Without Teacher Supervision
summary: Score-based distillation methods (e.g., variational score distillation) train one-step diffusion models by first pre-training a teacher score model and then distilling it into a one-step student model. However, the gradient estimator in the distillation stage usually suffers from two sources of bias: (1) biased teacher supervision due to score estimation error incurred during pre-training, and (2) the student model's score estimation error during distillation. These biases can degrade the quality of the resulting one-step diffusion model. To address this, we propose DiffRatio, a new framework for training one-step diffusion models: instead of estimating the teacher and student scores independently and then taking their difference, we directly estimate the score difference as the gradient of a learned log density ratio between the student and data distributions across diffusion time steps. This approach greatly simplifies the training pipeline, significantly reduces gradient estimation bias, and improves one-step generation quality. Additionally, it also reduces auxiliary network size by using a lightweight density-ratio network instead of two full score networks, which improves computational and memory efficiency. DiffRatio achieves competitive one-step generation results on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet (64x64 and 512x512), outperforming most teacher-supervised distillation methods. Moreover, the learned density ratio naturally serves as a verifier, enabling a principled inference-time parallel scaling scheme that further improves the generation quality without external rewards or additional sequential computation.

AI.title_translation: DiffRatio：在无需教师监督的情况下训练一步扩散模型
AI.tldr: DiffRatio通过直接学习密度比的梯度来训练一步扩散模型，避免了传统蒸馏中教师和学生模型分数估计误差带来的偏差，从而在简化训练、提高效率和生成质量方面优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于分数的蒸馏方法（如变分分数蒸馏）在蒸馏阶段存在两方面偏差：教师监督带来的分数估计误差和学生模型自身的分数估计误差，这些偏差会降低一步扩散模型的质量。
AI.method: 提出DiffRatio框架，直接估计跨扩散时间步长学生分布与数据分布之间的学习到的对数密度比的梯度，用作训练梯度，而不是独立估计教师和学生分数然后求差。它使用一个轻量级的密度比网络代替两个完整的评分网络。
AI.result: DiffRatio显著减少了梯度估计偏差，简化了训练流程，提高了计算和内存效率，并在CIFAR-10和ImageNet（64x64和512x512）上实现了具有竞争力的、优于大多数教师监督蒸馏方法的单步生成结果。其学习到的密度比还支持一种无需外部奖励或额外顺序计算的推理时并行缩放方案。
AI.conclusion: DiffRatio通过直接估计学习到的对数密度比的梯度来训练一步扩散模型，从而显著减少了梯度估计偏差，简化了训练流程，提高了计算和内存效率，并实现了具有竞争力的生成质量，同时其学习到的密度比还可用于无外部奖励的推理时并行缩放。
AI.translation: 基于分数的蒸馏方法（例如变分分数蒸馏）通过首先预训练一个教师分数模型，然后将其蒸馏到一个一步学生模型来训练一步扩散模型。然而，蒸馏阶段的梯度估计器通常受到两个偏差来源的困扰：（1）预训练期间发生的分数估计误差导致的有偏教师监督，和（2）蒸馏期间学生模型自身的分数估计误差。这些偏差会降低所得一步扩散模型的质量。为解决此问题，我们提出了DiffRatio，一个用于训练一步扩散模型的新框架：我们不是独立估计教师和学生分数然后求差，而是直接估计分数差，作为跨扩散时间步长学生分布与数据分布之间学习到的对数密度比的梯度。这种方法极大地简化了训练流程，显著减少了梯度估计偏差，并提高了单步生成质量。此外，它还通过使用轻量级的密度比网络代替两个完整的评分网络，减少了辅助网络的尺寸，从而提高了计算和内存效率。DiffRatio在CIFAR-10和ImageNet（64x64和512x512）上实现了具有竞争力的单步生成结果，优于大多数教师监督的蒸馏方法。此外，学习到的密度比自然地充当一个验证器，使得一种原则性的推理时并行缩放方案成为可能，该方案在没有外部奖励或额外顺序计算的情况下进一步提高了生成质量。
AI.summary: DiffRatio提出了一种新的框架来训练一步扩散模型，通过直接估计学生分布与数据分布之间学习到的对数密度比的梯度来替代传统的教师分数蒸馏。这种方法有效减少了梯度估计偏差，简化了训练流程，提高了效率，并在各种数据集上取得了优于现有蒸馏方法的性能，同时其密度比还支持额外的推理时间质量提升。
AI.keywords: 一步扩散模型, 分数蒸馏, 密度比, 梯度偏差, 无监督训练
AI.comments: 该方法的创新点在于直接估计分数差异（作为密度比的对数导数），从而避免了传统知识蒸馏中教师和学生模型独立估计分数带来的双重偏差。它简化了训练流程，提高了计算和内存效率，并在生成质量上超越了大多数教师监督的蒸馏方法。其潜在的局限性可能在于密度比模型的准确性，尽管它被设计为减轻分数估计误差。

title: Randomly Wrong Signals: Bayesian Auction Design with ML Predictions
summary: We study auction design when a seller relies on machine-learning predictions of bidders' valuations that may be unreliable. Motivated by modern ML systems that are often accurate but occasionally fail in a way that is essentially uninformative, we model predictions as randomly wrong: with high probability the signal equals the bidder's true value, and otherwise it is a hallucination independent of the value. We analyze revenue-maximizing auctions when the seller publicly reveals these signals. A central difficulty is that the resulting posterior belief combines a continuous distribution with a point mass at the signal, so standard Myerson techniques do not directly apply. We provide a tractable characterization of the optimal signal-revealing auction by providing a closed-form characterization of the appropriate ironed virtual values. This characterization yields simple and intuitive implications. With a single bidder, the optimal mechanism reduces to a posted-price policy with a small number of regimes: the seller ignores low signals, follows intermediate signals, caps moderately high signals, and may again follow very high signals. With multiple bidders, we show that a simple eager second-price auction with signal-dependent reserve prices performs nearly optimally in numerical experiments and substantially outperforms natural benchmarks that either ignore the signal or treat it as fully reliable.

AI.title_translation: 随机错误信号：带有机器学习预测的贝叶斯拍卖设计
AI.tldr: 当机器学习预测是随机错误的时（高概率正确，低概率完全误导），我们为信号揭示拍卖设计了一个可行的最优机制，通过计算“熨烫虚拟价值”得到解析解，发现最优策略会根据信号的质量采取不同的行动（忽略、遵循、限制等）。
AI.motivation: 研究背景是当卖方依赖于可能不可靠的机器学习预测（这些预测通常准确但偶尔会以一种本质上不提供信息的方式失效）时，拍卖设计的问题。
AI.method: 分析了在信号为“随机错误”的模型下，卖方公开揭示信号时的收入最大化拍卖。通过对适当的“熨烫虚拟价值”进行闭式表征，从而得到了最优信号揭示拍卖的特征描述。对于多竞标者，通过数值实验评估了信号依赖的保留价格的“急切第二价格拍卖”的性能。
AI.result: 得出了最优信号揭示拍卖的特征描述，通过对适当的熨烫虚拟价值进行闭式表征解决了标准 Myerson 技术无法直接应用的问题。单竞标者情况下，最优机制简化为忽略低信号、遵循中等信号、限制中高信号，并可能再次遵循非常高信号的标价策略。
AI.conclusion: 对于单竞标者，最优机制简化为具有少量制度的标价策略；对于多竞标者，带有信号依赖的保留价格的简单“急切第二价格拍卖”在数值上表现接近最优，并显著优于忽略信号或将其视为完全可靠的基准。
AI.translation: 我们研究了当卖方依赖于可能不可靠的机器学习预测的拍卖设计。受现代机器学习系统通常准确但偶尔会以一种本质上不提供信息的方式失效的启发，我们将预测建模为随机错误的：高概率下信号等于竞标者的真实价值，否则是独立于价值的幻觉。我们分析了卖方公开揭示这些信号时的收入最大化拍卖。一个主要的困难是由此产生的后验信念结合了连续分布和信号处的点质量，因此标准的 Myerson 技术不能直接应用。我们通过提供适当的“熨烫虚拟价值”的闭式表征，为最优信号揭示拍卖提供了一个可行的特征描述。该特征描述产生了简单直观的含义。对于单竞标者，最优机制简化为一种具有少量制度的标价策略：卖方忽略低信号，遵循中等信号，限制中高信号，并可能再次遵循非常高的信号。对于多竞标者，我们表明带有信号依赖的保留价格的简单“急切第二价格拍卖”在数值实验中表现接近最优，并且显著优于忽略信号或将其视为完全可靠的自然基准。
AI.summary: 本文研究了卖方依赖可能不可靠的机器学习预测的拍卖设计问题，提出了一种“随机错误信号”模型来描述预测的不可靠性。研究人员通过对“熨烫虚拟价值”的闭式表征，为最优信号揭示拍卖提供了可行且直观的解析特征，并展示了单竞标者和多竞标者情况下的具体机制表现。
AI.keywords: 拍卖设计, 机器学习预测, 随机错误信号, 虚拟价值, 信号揭示
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了“随机错误信号”的模型来描述机器学习预测的不可靠性，并为信号揭示拍卖设计提供了可行的解决方案，特别是通过“熨烫虚拟价值”实现了最优拍卖的解析解。其重要性在于将现代机器学习的实际局限性引入到经典的拍卖理论中。局限性是，对多方博弈的分析主要依赖于数值实验，而非解析证明。

title: Summaries as Centroids for Interpretable and Scalable Text Clustering
summary: We introduce k-NLPmeans and k-LLMmeans, text-clustering variants of k-means that periodically replace numeric centroids with textual summaries. The key idea, summary-as-centroid, retains k-means assignments in embedding space while producing human-readable, auditable cluster prototypes. The method is LLM-optional: k-NLPmeans uses lightweight, deterministic summarizers, enabling offline, low-cost, and stable operation; k-LLMmeans is a drop-in upgrade that uses an LLM for summaries under a fixed per-iteration budget whose cost does not grow with dataset size. We also present a mini-batch extension for real-time clustering of streaming text. Across diverse datasets, embedding models, and summarization strategies, our approach consistently outperforms classical baselines and approaches the accuracy of recent LLM-based clustering-without extensive LLM calls. Finally, we provide a case study on sequential text streams and release a StackExchange-derived benchmark for evaluating streaming text clustering.

AI.title_translation: 摘要作为质心：用于可解释和可扩展的文本聚类
AI.tldr: 研究提出了一种新的文本聚类方法（k-NLPmeans/k-LLMmeans），它用文本摘要作为聚类中心（质心），使得聚类结果人类可读且易于审计。该方法性能优于传统方法，且不依赖大量的LLM调用，并支持实时流式数据处理。
AI.motivation: 在文本聚类中，传统的数值质心缺乏可读性和可审计性。需要一种方法在保留嵌入空间中聚类分配的同时，生成人类可读、可审计的聚类原型。
AI.method: 引入了k-NLPmeans和k-LLMmeans，它们是k-means的文本聚类变体，通过周期性地用文本摘要替换数值质心来实现“摘要即质心”的思想。k-NLPmeans使用轻量级、确定的摘要器；k-LLMmeans使用LLM生成摘要，但受限于固定的每迭代预算。还提出了用于实时流式文本聚类的mini-batch扩展。
AI.result: 在不同的数据集、嵌入模型和摘要策略中，该方法一致地超越了经典基线，并且准确率接近最近的、需要大量LLM调用的聚类方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在不同的数据集、嵌入模型和摘要策略中一致地优于经典基线，并且在不进行大量LLM调用的情况下，其准确性可与最新的基于LLM的聚类方法相媲美。此外，研究还提供了一个关于顺序文本流的案例研究，并发布了一个用于评估流式文本聚类的基准。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了k-NLPmeans和k-LLMmeans，它们是k-means的文本聚类变体，通过周期性地用文本摘要替换数值质心。核心思想是“摘要即质心”，它在嵌入空间中保留了k-means的分配，同时生成了人类可读、可审计的聚类原型。该方法是LLM可选的：k-NLPmeans使用轻量级、确定的摘要器，支持离线、低成本和稳定的操作；k-LLMmeans是一个即插即用的升级，它在固定的每迭代预算下使用LLM生成摘要，且成本不随数据集大小增长。我们还提出了一个用于实时流式文本聚类的mini-batch扩展。在不同的数据集、嵌入模型和摘要策略中，我们的方法一致地优于经典基线，并且在不进行大量LLM调用的情况下，其准确性可与最近的基于LLM的聚类方法相媲美。最后，我们提供了一个关于顺序文本流的案例研究，并发布了一个源自StackExchange的用于评估流式文本聚类的基准。
AI.summary: 本文提出了k-NLPmeans和k-LLMmeans两种k-means的文本聚类变体，其核心是“摘要即质心”：用可读的文本摘要周期性地替换数值质心，从而实现可解释和可审计的聚类。该方法灵活（LLM可选），并提供了用于流式数据的mini-batch扩展，实验证明其性能优于经典基线，且准确性接近最新的LLM聚类方法。
AI.keywords: 文本聚类, 摘要即质心, k-means, 可解释性, 流式聚类
AI.comments: 该方法的核心创新在于将文本聚类中的数值质心替换为可读的文本摘要（summary-as-centroid），这显著提高了聚类的可解释性和可审计性。k-NLPmeans的轻量级特性和k-LLMmeans的LLM可选性提供了灵活性。该方法在性能上超越了经典基线，并接近了需要大量LLM调用的最新方法。缺点是k-LLMmeans的成本虽然不随数据集大小线性增长，但仍受限于每迭代的固定预算。

title: Provably Efficient RL under Episode-Wise Safety in Constrained MDPs with Linear Function Approximation
summary: We study the reinforcement learning (RL) problem in a constrained Markov decision process (CMDP), where an agent explores the environment to maximize the expected cumulative reward while satisfying a single constraint on the expected total utility value in every episode. While this problem is well understood in the tabular setting, theoretical results for function approximation remain scarce. This paper closes the gap by proposing an RL algorithm for linear CMDPs that achieves $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K})$ regret with an episode-wise zero-violation guarantee. Furthermore, our method is computationally efficient, scaling polynomially with problem-dependent parameters while remaining independent of the state space size. Our results significantly improve upon recent linear CMDP algorithms, which either violate the constraint or incur exponential computational costs.

title: MAnchors: Memorization-Based Acceleration of Anchors via Rule Reuse and Transformation
summary: Anchors is a popular local model-agnostic explanation technique whose applicability is limited by its computational inefficiency. To address this limitation, we propose a memorization-based framework that accelerates Anchors while preserving explanation fidelity and interpretability. Our approach leverages the iterative nature of Anchors' algorithm which gradually refines an explanation until it is precise enough for a given input by storing and reusing intermediate results obtained during prior explanations. Specifically, we maintain a memory of low-precision, high-coverage rules and introduce a rule transformation framework to adapt them to new inputs: the horizontal transformation adapts a pre-trained explanation to the current input by replacing features, and the vertical transformation refines the general explanation until it is precise enough for the input. We evaluate our method across tabular, text, and image datasets, demonstrating that it significantly reduces explanation generation time while maintaining fidelity and interpretability, thereby enabling the practical adoption of Anchors in time-sensitive applications.

title: Reducing Hallucinations in Language Model-based SPARQL Query Generation Using Post-Generation Memory Retrieval
summary: The ability to generate SPARQL queries from natural language questions is crucial for ensuring efficient and accurate retrieval of structured data from knowledge graphs (KG). While large language models (LLMs) have been widely adopted for SPARQL query generation, they are often susceptible to hallucinations and out-of-distribution errors when generating KG elements, such as Uniform Resource Identifiers (URIs), based on opaque internal parametric knowledge. We propose PGMR (Post-Generation Memory Retrieval), a modular framework where the LLM produces an intermediate query using natural language placeholders for URIs, and a non-parametric memory module is subsequently employed to retrieve and resolve the correct KG URIs. PGMR significantly enhances query correctness (SQM) across various LLMs, datasets, and distribution shifts, while achieving the near-complete suppression of URI hallucinations. Critically, we demonstrate PGMR's superior safety and robustness: a retrieval confidence threshold enables PGMR to effectively refuse to answer queries that lack support, and the retriever proves highly resilient to memory noise, maintaining strong performance even when the non-parametric memory size is scaled up to 9 times with irrelevant, distracting entities.

title: BAGEL: Projection-Free Algorithm for Adversarially Constrained Online Convex Optimization
summary: Projection-based algorithms for Constrained Online Convex Optimization (COCO) achieve optimal $\mathcal{O}(T^{1/2})$ regret guarantees but face scalability challenges due to the computational complexity of projections. To circumvent this, projection-free methods utilizing Linear Optimization Oracles (LOO) have been proposed, albeit typically achieving slower $\mathcal{O}(T^{3/4})$ regret rates. In this work, we examine whether the $\mathcal{O}(T^{1/2})$ rate can be recovered in the projection-free setting by strengthening the oracle assumption. We introduce BAGEL, an algorithm utilizing a Separation Oracle (SO) that achieves $\mathcal{O}(T^{1/2})$ regret and $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{1/2})$ cumulative constraint violation (CCV) for convex cost functions. Our analysis shows that by leveraging an infeasible projection via SO, we can match the time-horizon dependence of projection-based methods with $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T)$ oracle calls, provided dependence on the geometry of the action set. This establishes a specific regime where projection-free methods can attain the same convergence rates as projection-based counterparts.

title: Simple Sublinear Algorithms for $(Δ+1)$ Vertex Coloring via Asymmetric Palette Sparsification
comments: 18 pages. This is the TheoretiCS journal version
summary:
The palette sparsification theorem (PST) of Assadi, Chen, and Khanna (SODA 2019) states that in every graph $G$ with maximum degree $Δ$, sampling a list of $O(\log{n})$ colors from $\{1,\ldots,Δ+1\}$ for every vertex independently and uniformly, with high probability, allows for finding a $(Δ+1)$ vertex coloring of $G$ by coloring each vertex only from its sampled list. PST naturally leads to a host of sublinear algorithms for $(Δ+1)$ vertex coloring, including in semi-streaming, sublinear time, and MPC models, which are all proven to be nearly optimal, and in the case of the former two are the only known sublinear algorithms for this problem.
  While being a quite natural and simple-to-state theorem, PST suffers from two drawbacks. Firstly, all its known proofs require technical arguments that rely on sophisticated graph decompositions and probabilistic arguments. Secondly, finding the coloring of the graph from the sampled lists in an efficient manner requires a considerably complicated algorithm.
  We show that a natural weakening of PST addresses both these drawbacks while still leading to sublinear algorithms of similar quality (up to polylog factors). In particular, we prove an asymmetric palette sparsification theorem (APST) that allows for list sizes of the vertices to have different sizes and only bounds the average size of these lists. The benefit of this weaker requirement is that we can now easily show the graph can be $(Δ+1)$ colored from the sampled lists using the standard greedy coloring algorithm. This way, we can recover nearly-optimal bounds for $(Δ+1)$ vertex coloring in all the aforementioned models using algorithms that are much simpler to implement and analyze.

title: Legged Robot State Estimation Using Invariant Neural-Augmented Kalman Filter with a Neural Compensator
summary: This paper presents an algorithm to improve state estimation for legged robots. Among existing model-based state estimation methods for legged robots, the contact-aided invariant extended Kalman filter defines the state on a Lie group to preserve invariance, thereby significantly accelerating convergence. It achieves more accurate state estimation by leveraging contact information as measurements for the update step. However, when the model exhibits strong nonlinearity, the estimation accuracy decreases. Such nonlinearities can cause initial errors to accumulate and lead to large drifts over time. To address this issue, we propose compensating for errors by augmenting the Kalman filter with an artificial neural network serving as a nonlinear function approximator. Furthermore, we design this neural network to respect the Lie group structure to ensure invariance, resulting in our proposed Invariant Neural-Augmented Kalman Filter (InNKF). The proposed algorithm offers improved state estimation performance by combining the strengths of model-based and learning-based approaches. Project webpage: https://seokju-lee.github.io/innkf_webpage

title: Compositional Reasoning with Transformers, RNNs, and Chain of Thought
summary: It is well understood that different neural network architectures are suited to different tasks, but is there always a single best architecture for a given task? We compare the expressive power of transformers, RNNs, and transformers with chain of thought tokens on a simple and natural class of tasks we term Compositional Reasoning Questions (CRQ). This family captures multi-step problems with tree-like compositional structure, such as evaluating Boolean formulas. We prove that under standard hardness assumptions, \emph{none} of these three architectures is capable of solving CRQs unless some hyperparameter (depth, embedding dimension, and number of chain of thought tokens, respectively) grows with the size of the input. We then provide constructions for solving CRQs with each architecture. For transformers, our construction uses depth that is logarithmic in the problem size. For RNNs, logarithmic embedding dimension is necessary and sufficient, so long as the inputs are provided in a certain order. For transformers with chain of thought, our construction uses $n$ CoT tokens for input size $n$. These results show that, while CRQs are inherently hard, there are several different ways for language models to overcome this hardness. Even for a single class of problems, each architecture has strengths and weaknesses, and none is strictly better than the others.

title: Depth-Width tradeoffs in Algorithmic Reasoning of Graph Tasks with Transformers
summary: Transformers have revolutionized the field of machine learning. In particular, they can be used to solve complex algorithmic problems, including graph-based tasks. In such algorithmic tasks a key question is what is the minimal size of a transformer that can implement the task. Recent work has begun to explore this problem for graph-based tasks, showing that for sub-linear embedding dimension (i.e., model width) logarithmic depth suffices. However, an open question, which we address here, is what happens if width is allowed to grow linearly, while depth is kept fixed. Here we analyze this setting, and provide the surprising result that with linear width, constant depth suffices for solving a host of graph-based problems. This suggests that a moderate increase in width can allow much shallower models, which are advantageous in terms of inference and train time. For other problems, we show that quadratic width is required. Our results demonstrate the complex and intriguing landscape of transformer implementations of graph-based algorithms. We empirically investigate these trade-offs between the relative powers of depth and width and find tasks where wider models have the same accuracy as deep models, while having much faster train and inference time due to parallelizable hardware.

title: Rewarding Doubt: A Reinforcement Learning Approach to Calibrated Confidence Expression of Large Language Models
summary: A safe and trustworthy use of Large Language Models (LLMs) requires an accurate expression of confidence in their answers. We propose a novel Reinforcement Learning approach that allows to directly fine-tune LLMs to express calibrated confidence estimates alongside their answers to factual questions. Our method optimizes a reward based on the logarithmic scoring rule, explicitly penalizing both over- and under-confidence. This encourages the model to align its confidence estimates with the actual predictive accuracy. The optimal policy under our reward design would result in perfectly calibrated confidence expressions. Unlike prior approaches that decouple confidence estimation from response generation, our method integrates confidence calibration seamlessly into the generative process of the LLM. Empirically, we demonstrate that models trained with our approach exhibit substantially improved calibration and generalize to unseen tasks without further fine-tuning, suggesting the emergence of general confidence awareness.

title: EgoLife: Towards Egocentric Life Assistant
comments: Accepted to CVPR 2025. Project Page: https://egolife-ai.github.io/. Code: https://github.com/EvolvingLMMs-Lab/EgoLife
summary: We introduce EgoLife, a project to develop an egocentric life assistant that accompanies and enhances personal efficiency through AI-powered wearable glasses. To lay the foundation for this assistant, we conducted a comprehensive data collection study where six participants lived together for one week, continuously recording their daily activities - including discussions, shopping, cooking, socializing, and entertainment - using AI glasses for multimodal egocentric video capture, along with synchronized third-person-view video references. This effort resulted in the EgoLife Dataset, a comprehensive 300-hour egocentric, interpersonal, multiview, and multimodal daily life dataset with intensive annotation. Leveraging this dataset, we introduce EgoLifeQA, a suite of long-context, life-oriented question-answering tasks designed to provide meaningful assistance in daily life by addressing practical questions such as recalling past relevant events, monitoring health habits, and offering personalized recommendations. To address the key technical challenges of (1) developing robust visual-audio models for egocentric data, (2) enabling identity recognition, and (3) facilitating long-context question answering over extensive temporal information, we introduce EgoButler, an integrated system comprising EgoGPT and EgoRAG. EgoGPT is an omni-modal model trained on egocentric datasets, achieving state-of-the-art performance on egocentric video understanding. EgoRAG is a retrieval-based component that supports answering ultra-long-context questions. Our experimental studies verify their working mechanisms and reveal critical factors and bottlenecks, guiding future improvements. By releasing our datasets, models, and benchmarks, we aim to stimulate further research in egocentric AI assistants.

title: Achievable Rate Regions for Multi-terminal Quantum Channels via Coset Codes
comments: This version includes (i) new additive and non-additive, non-commutative examples that establish the suboptimality of unstructured IID coding strategies in classical-quantum settings, and (ii) detailed proofs of the coding theorems
summary: We undertake a Shannon theoretic study of the problem of communicating bit streams over a 3-user quantum interference channel (QIC) and focus on characterizing inner bounds. Adopting the powerful technique of tilting, smoothing, and augmentation discovered by Sen recently, and combining with our coset code strategy, we derive a new inner bound to the classical-quantum capacity region of a 3-user QIC. The derived inner bound subsumes all currently known bounds and is proven to be strictly larger for identified examples.

title: AdaSCALE: Adaptive Scaling for OOD Detection
summary: The ability of the deep learning model to recognize when a sample falls outside its learned distribution is critical for safe and reliable deployment. Recent state-of-the-art out-of-distribution (OOD) detection methods leverage activation shaping to improve the separation between in-distribution (ID) and OOD inputs. These approaches resort to sample-specific scaling but apply a static percentile threshold across all samples regardless of their nature, resulting in suboptimal ID-OOD separability. In this work, we propose \textbf{AdaSCALE}, an adaptive scaling procedure that dynamically adjusts the percentile threshold based on a sample's estimated OOD likelihood. This estimation leverages our key observation: OOD samples exhibit significantly more pronounced activation shifts at high-magnitude activations under minor perturbation compared to ID samples. AdaSCALE enables stronger scaling for likely ID samples and weaker scaling for likely OOD samples, yielding highly separable energy scores. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art OOD detection performance, outperforming the latest rival OptFS by 14.94% in near-OOD and 21.67% in far-OOD datasets in average FPR@95 metric on the ImageNet-1k benchmark across eight diverse architectures. The code is available at: https://github.com/sudarshanregmi/AdaSCALE/

title: Neuro Symbolic Knowledge Reasoning for Procedural Video Question Answering
comments: This paper is under review at IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems. Personal use is permitted, but republication/redistribution requires IEEE permission
summary: In this work we present Knowledge Module Learning (KML) to understand and reason over procedural tasks that requires models to learn structured and compositional procedural knowledge. KML is a neurosymbolic framework that learns relation categories within a knowledge graph as neural knowledge modules and composes them into executable reasoning programs generated by large language models (LLMs). Each module encodes a specific procedural relation capturing how each entity type such as tools are related to steps, purpose of each tool, and steps of each task. Given a question conditioned on a task shown in a video, then KML performs multistep reasoning with transparent, traceable intermediate states. Our theoretical analysis demonstrated two desired properties of KML. KML satisfy strong optimal conditions for modelling KG relations as neural mappings, providing strong foundations for generalizable procedural reasoning. It also shows a bound on the expected error when it performs multistep reasoning. To evaluate this model, we construct a large procedural knowledge graph (PKG) consisting of diverse instructional domains by integrating the COIN instructional video dataset, and COIN ontology, commonsense relations from ConceptNet, and structured extractions from LLMs, followed by expert verification. We then generate question and answer pairs by applying graph traversal templates over the PKG, constructing the PKR-QA benchmark for procedural knowledge reasoning. Experiments show that KML improves structured reasoning performance while providing interpretable step-by-step traces, outperforming LLM-only and black-box neural baselines. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/LUNAProject22/KML.

title: Machine learning surrogate models of many-body dispersion interactions in polymer melts
summary: Accurate prediction of many-body dispersion (MBD) interactions is essential for understanding the van der Waals forces that govern the behavior of many complex molecular systems. However, the high computational cost of MBD calculations limits their direct application in large-scale simulations. In this work, we introduce a machine learning surrogate model specifically designed to predict MBD forces in polymer melts, a system that demands accurate MBD description and offers structural advantages for machine learning approaches. Our model is based on a trimmed SchNet architecture that selectively retains the most relevant atomic connections and incorporates trainable radial basis functions for geometric encoding. We validate our surrogate model on datasets from polyethylene, polypropylene, and polyvinyl chloride melts, demonstrating high predictive accuracy and robust generalization across diverse polymer systems. In addition, the model captures key physical features, such as the characteristic decay behavior of MBD interactions, providing valuable insights for optimizing cutoff strategies. Characterized by high computational efficiency, our surrogate model enables practical incorporation of MBD effects into large-scale molecular simulations.

title: Convergence analysis of SPH method on irregular particle distributions for the Poisson equation
summary: The numerical accuracy of particle-based approximations in Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics (SPH) is significantly affected by the spatial uniformity of particle distributions, especially for second-order derivatives. This study aims to enhance the accuracy of SPH method and analyze its convergence with irregular particle distributions. By establishing regularity conditions for particle distributions, we ensure that the local truncation error of traditional SPH formulations, including first and second derivatives, achieves second-order accuracy. Our proposed method, the volume reconstruction SPH method, guarantees these regularity conditions while preserving the discrete maximum principle. Benefiting from the discrete maximum principle, we conduct a rigorous global error analysis in the $L^\infty$-norm for the Poisson equation with variable coefficients, achieving second-order convergence. Numerical examples are presented to validate the theoretical findings.

title: CAPE: Connectivity-Aware Path Enforcement Loss for Curvilinear Structure Delineation
summary: Promoting the connectivity of curvilinear structures, such as neuronal processes in biomedical scans and blood vessels in CT images, remains a key challenge in semantic segmentation. Traditional pixel-wise loss functions, including cross-entropy and Dice losses, often fail to capture high-level topological connectivity, resulting in topological mistakes in graphs obtained from prediction maps. In this paper, we propose CAPE (Connectivity-Aware Path Enforcement), a novel loss function designed to enforce connectivity in graphs obtained from segmentation maps by optimizing a graph connectivity metric. CAPE uses the graph representation of the ground truth to select node pairs and determine their corresponding paths within the predicted segmentation through a shortest-path algorithm. Using this, we penalize both disconnections and false positive connections, effectively promoting the model to preserve topological correctness. Experiments on 2D and 3D datasets, including neuron and blood vessel tracing demonstrate that CAPE significantly improves topology-aware metrics and outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

title: Smart Exploration in Reinforcement Learning using Bounded Uncertainty Models
comments: Presented at 64th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control, CDC 2025, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, 2025
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a powerful framework for decision-making in uncertain environments, but it often requires large amounts of data to learn an optimal policy. We address this challenge by incorporating prior model knowledge to guide exploration and accelerate the learning process. Specifically, we assume access to a model set that contains the true transition kernel and reward function. We optimize over this model set to obtain upper and lower bounds on the Q-function, which are then used to guide the exploration of the agent. We provide theoretical guarantees on the convergence of the Q-function to the optimal Q-function under the proposed class of exploring policies. Furthermore, we also introduce a data-driven regularized version of the model set optimization problem that ensures the convergence of the class of exploring policies to the optimal policy. Lastly, we show that when the model set has a specific structure, namely the bounded-parameter MDP (BMDP) framework, the regularized model set optimization problem becomes convex and simple to implement. In this setting, we also prove finite-time convergence to the optimal policy under mild assumptions. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed exploration strategy, which we call BUMEX (Bounded Uncertainty Model-based Exploration), in a simulation study. The results indicate that the proposed method can significantly accelerate learning in benchmark examples. A toolbox is available at https://github.com/JvHulst/BUMEX.

title: Semantic Depth Matters: Explaining Errors of Deep Vision Networks through Perceived Class Similarities
summary: Understanding deep neural network (DNN) behavior requires more than evaluating classification accuracy alone; analyzing errors and their predictability is equally crucial. Current evaluation methodologies lack transparency, particularly in explaining the underlying causes of network misclassifications. To address this, we introduce a novel framework that investigates the relationship between the semantic hierarchy depth perceived by a network and its real-data misclassification patterns. Central to our framework is the Similarity Depth (SD) metric, which quantifies the semantic hierarchy depth perceived by a network along with a method of evaluation of how closely the network's errors align with its internally perceived similarity structure. We also propose a graph-based visualization of model semantic relationships and misperceptions. A key advantage of our approach is that leveraging class templates -- representations derived from classifier layer weights -- is applicable to already trained networks without requiring additional data or experiments. Our approach reveals that deep vision networks encode specific semantic hierarchies and that high semantic depth improves the compliance between perceived class similarities and actual errors.

title: XY-Cut++: Advanced Layout Ordering via Hierarchical Mask Mechanism on a Novel Benchmark
summary: Document Reading Order Recovery is a fundamental task in document image understanding, playing a pivotal role in enhancing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and serving as a critical preprocessing step for large language models (LLMs). Existing methods often struggle with complex layouts(e.g., multi-column newspapers), high-overhead interactions between cross-modal elements (visual regions and textual semantics), and a lack of robust evaluation benchmarks. We introduce XY-Cut++, an advanced layout ordering method that integrates pre-mask processing, multi-granularity segmentation, and cross-modal matching to address these challenges. Our method significantly enhances layout ordering accuracy compared to traditional XY-Cut techniques. Specifically, XY-Cut++ achieves state-of-the-art performance (98.8 BLEU overall) while maintaining simplicity and efficiency. It outperforms existing baselines by up to 24\% and demonstrates consistent accuracy across simple and complex layouts on the newly introduced DocBench-100 dataset. This advancement establishes a reliable foundation for document structure recovery, setting a new standard for layout ordering tasks and facilitating more effective RAG and LLM preprocessing.

title: Diffusion Generative Recommendation with Continuous Tokens
comments: Accepted by The ACM Web Conference (WWW 2026)
summary: Recent advances in generative artificial intelligence, particularly large language models (LLMs), have opened new opportunities for enhancing recommender systems (RecSys). Most existing LLM-based RecSys approaches operate in a discrete space, using vector-quantized tokenizers to align with the inherent discrete nature of language models. However, these quantization methods often result in lossy tokenization and suboptimal learning, primarily due to inaccurate gradient propagation caused by the non-differentiable argmin operation in standard vector quantization. Inspired by the emerging trend of embracing continuous tokens in language models, we propose ContRec, a novel framework that seamlessly integrates continuous tokens into LLM-based RecSys. Specifically, ContRec consists of two key modules: a sigma-VAE Tokenizer, which encodes users/items with continuous tokens; and a Dispersive Diffusion module, which captures implicit user preference. The tokenizer is trained with a continuous Variational Auto-Encoder (VAE) objective, where three effective techniques are adopted to avoid representation collapse. By conditioning on the previously generated tokens of the LLM backbone during user modeling, the Dispersive Diffusion module performs a conditional diffusion process with a novel Dispersive Loss, enabling high-quality user preference generation through next-token diffusion. Finally, ContRec leverages both the textual reasoning output from the LLM and the latent representations produced by the diffusion model for Top-K item retrieval, thereby delivering comprehensive recommendation results. Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate that ContRec consistently outperforms both traditional and SOTA LLM-based recommender systems. Our results highlight the potential of continuous tokenization and generative modeling for advancing the next generation of recommender systems.
comment: Accepted by The ACM Web Conference (WWW 2026)

title: On the Need to Rethink Trust in AI Assistants for Software Development: A Critical Review
comments: 18 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering
summary: Trust is a fundamental concept in human decision-making and collaboration that has long been studied in philosophy and psychology. However, software engineering (SE) articles often use the term trust informally; providing an explicit definition or embedding results in established trust models is rare. In SE research on AI assistants, this practice culminates in equating trust with the likelihood of accepting generated content, which, in isolation, does not capture the full conceptual complexity of trust. Without a common definition, true secondary research on trust is impossible. The objectives of our research were: (1) to present the psychological and philosophical foundations of human trust, (2) to systematically study how trust is conceptualized in SE and the related disciplines human-computer interaction and information systems, and (3) to discuss limitations of equating trust with content acceptance, outlining how SE research can adopt existing trust models to overcome the widespread informal use of the term trust. We conducted a literature review across disciplines and a critical review of recent SE articles with a focus on trust conceptualizations. We found that trust is rarely defined or conceptualized in SE articles. Related disciplines commonly embed their methodology and results in established trust models, clearly distinguishing, for example, between initial trust and trust formation and between appropriate and inappropriate trust. On a meta-scientific level, other disciplines even discuss whether and when trust can be applied to AI assistants at all. Our study reveals a significant maturity gap of trust research in SE compared to other disciplines. We provide concrete recommendations on how SE researchers can adopt established trust models and instruments to study trust in AI assistants beyond the acceptance of generated software artifacts.
comment: 18 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering

title: Physics-Guided Multimodal Transformers are the Necessary Foundation for the Next Generation of Meteorological Science
summary: This position paper argues that the next generation of artificial intelligence in meteorological and climate sciences must transition from fragmented hybrid heuristics toward a unified paradigm of physics-guided multimodal transformers. While purely data-driven models have achieved significant gains in predictive accuracy, they often treat atmospheric processes as mere visual patterns, frequently producing results that lack scientific consistency or violate fundamental physical laws. We contend that current ``hybrid'' attempts to bridge this gap remain ad-hoc and struggle to scale across the heterogeneous nature of meteorological data ranging from satellite imagery to sparse sensor measurements. We argue that the transformer architecture, through its inherent capacity for cross-modal alignment, provides the only viable foundation for a systematic integration of domain knowledge via physical constraint embedding and physics-informed loss functions. By advocating for this unified architectural shift, we aim to steer the community away from ``black-box'' curve fitting and toward AI systems that are inherently falsifiable, scientifically grounded, and robust enough to address the existential challenges of extreme weather and climate change.

title: NoWag: A Unified Framework for Shape Preserving Compression of Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit remarkable performance across various natural language processing tasks but suffer from immense computational and memory demands, limiting their deployment in resource-constrained environments. To address this challenge, we propose NoWag (Normalized Weight and Activation Guided Compression), a unified framework for one-shot shape preserving compression algorithms. We apply NoWag to compress Llama-2 (7B, 13B, 70B) and Llama-3 (8B, 70B) models using two popular shape-preserving techniques: vector quantization (NoWag-VQ) and unstructured/semi-structured pruning (NoWag-P). Our results show that NoWag-VQ significantly outperforms state-of-the-art one-shot vector quantization methods, while NoWag-P performs competitively against leading pruning techniques. These findings highlight underlying commonalities between these compression paradigms and suggest promising directions for future research. Our code is available at https://github.com/LawrenceRLiu/NoWag

title: Range Image-Based Implicit Neural Compression for LiDAR Point Clouds
comments: Accepted for publication in IEEE Access
summary: This paper presents a novel scheme to efficiently compress Light Detection and Ranging~(LiDAR) point clouds, enabling high-precision 3D scene archives, and such archives pave the way for a detailed understanding of the corresponding 3D scenes. We focus on 2D range images~(RIs) as a lightweight format for representing 3D LiDAR observations. Although conventional image compression techniques can be adapted to improve compression efficiency for RIs, their practical performance is expected to be limited due to differences in bit precision and the distinct pixel value distribution characteristics between natural images and RIs. We propose a novel implicit neural representation~(INR)--based RI compression method that effectively handles floating-point valued pixels. The proposed method divides RIs into depth and mask images and compresses them using patch-wise and pixel-wise INR architectures with model pruning and quantization, respectively. Experiments on the KITTI dataset show that the proposed method outperforms existing image, point cloud, RI, and INR-based compression methods in terms of 3D reconstruction and detection quality at low bitrates and decoding latency.
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Access

title: Numerical analysis of an H(div)-conforming divergence-free DG method with a second-order explicit Runge-Kutta scheme for incompressible flows
comments: The manuscript is an unfinished preliminary version containing only initial ideas and partial results. Due to a change in research direction, the authors have decided to abandon further development of this draft and will not pursue publication of this work
summary: Recently, H(div)-conforming DG type methods coupled with Runge-Kutta (RK) time stepping have been widely employed for simulating high Reynolds number flows, with the convective terms treated explicitly. Although the analysis techniques of RKDG methods were well developed, the extension to incompressible flows is highly nontrivial due to the exactly divergence-free constraint, where the key lies in analyzing the convective terms. We neglect viscosity effects, and conduct an error analysis for an H(div)-conforming divergence-free DG method combined with a second-order explicit RK scheme, for the incompressible Euler equations. We derive an a priori error estimate of $O(h^{k+1 / 2}+τ^2)$ under a restrictive CFL condition $τ\lesssim h^{4 / 3}$ for polynomials of degree $k \geq 1$, where $h$ and $τ$ are the mesh size and time step size, respectively, assuming that the exact solution is smooth. For the case of linear polynomials, we investigate whether existing analytical techniques can relax the restrictive CFL condition to a standard CFL condition $τ\lesssim h$. It is demonstrated that the exactly divergence-free constraint prevents the application of these techniques. We conjecture that the error estimates for linear polynomials cannot be derived under a standard CFL condition. Finally, we mention that based on our analytical framework, our analytical results will be readily extended to the Navier-Stokes equations at high mesh Reynolds number, with the viscous and convective terms treated explicitly. Numerical experiments are conducted, supporting our analytical results and the conjecture for linear polynomials.
